title.zh: 卷十二 本紀第十二: 世祖九
title.raw: 卷十二 本紀第十二: 世祖九 Volume 12 Annals 12: Shizu 9

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月壬戌朔，高麗國王王春遣其大將軍金子廷來賀。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, spring, first month, on the renxu new moon, King Wang Chun of Goryeo dispatched his general-in-chief Jin Ziting to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, on the renxu new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent his general-in-chief Jin Ziting to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，罷征東行中書省。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the Japan Expedition Branch Secretariat was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Japan expedition branch secretariat was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，諸王劄剌忽至自軍中。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Prince Zhalahu arrived from the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Prince Zhalahu arrived from the army.

sentences.zh: 時皇子北平王以軍鎮阿裏麻裏之地，以禦海都。

translations.literal: At that time the imperial son, Prince of Beiping, had troops garrison the land of Alimali to guard against Kaidu.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the imperial son, Prince of Beiping, had troops garrison Alimali to guard against Kaidu.

sentences.zh: 諸王昔裏吉與脫脫木兒、棨木忽兒、撒裏蠻等謀劫皇子北平王以叛，欲與劄剌忽結援於海都，海都不從。

translations.literal: Prince Sheraqi, together with Tuotuo Mier, Qimuhuer, Sariman, and others, plotted to seize the Prince of Beiping and rebel, wishing to link arms through Zhalahu with Kaidu; Kaidu would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Sheraqi, together with Tuotuo Mier, Qimuhuer, Sariman, and others, plotted to seize the Prince of Beiping and rebel, hoping to ally through Zhalahu with Kaidu; Kaidu refused.

sentences.zh: 撒裏蠻悔過，執昔裏吉等，北平王遣劄剌忽以聞。

translations.literal: Sariman repented, seized Sheraqi and the others, and the Prince of Beiping sent Zhalahu to report it.
translations.idiomatic: Sariman repented, seized Sheraqi and the others, and the Prince of Beiping sent Zhalahu to report it.

sentences.zh: 妖民張圓光伏誅。

translations.literal: The sorcerer-subversive Zhang Roundong was executed.
translations.idiomatic: The sorcerer-subversive Zhang Roundong was executed.

sentences.zh: 立太僕院。

translations.literal: The Grand Stable Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Stable Office was established.

sentences.zh: 撥信州民四百八戶隸諸王柏木兒。

translations.literal: Four hundred eight Xinzhou households were assigned to Prince Bomuer.
translations.idiomatic: 408 Xinzhou households were assigned to Prince Bomuer.

sentences.zh: 丙子，車駕畋於近郊。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the imperial carriage hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the imperial carriage hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，高麗國王貢綢布四百匹。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the king of Goryeo presented four hundred bolts of silk cloth as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the king of Goryeo presented 400 bolts of silk cloth as tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜西平王怯薛那懷等鈔一萬一千五百二十一錠。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Keshig Naqun, Prince of Xiping, and others were granted eleven thousand five hundred twenty-one ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Keshig Naqun, Prince of Xiping, and others were granted 11,521 ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯朔，車駕幸柳林。

translations.literal: Second month, on the xinmao new moon, the imperial carriage visited Willow Grove.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinmao new moon, the imperial carriage visited Willow Grove.

sentences.zh: 饒州總管姚文龍言，江南財賦歲可辦鈔五十萬錠，詔以文龍為江西道宣慰使，兼措置茶法。

translations.literal: Raozhou route intendant Yao Wenlong said Jiangnan revenue could annually supply five hundred thousand ingots of paper currency; an edict made Wenlong Jiangxi Route pacification commissioner, concurrently arranging tea law.
translations.idiomatic: Raozhou route intendant Yao Wenlong said Jiangnan revenue could supply 500,000 ingots of paper currency annually; an edict made Wenlong Jiangxi Route pacification commissioner and put him in charge of tea law.

sentences.zh: 命司徒阿你哥、行工部尚書納懷制飾銅輪儀表刻漏。

translations.literal: Grand Steward Anige and acting minister of works Naqun were ordered to make and decorate copper wheel instruments, clepsydra, and sundial.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Steward Anige and acting minister of works Naqun were ordered to make and decorate copper wheel instruments, clepsydra, and sundial.

sentences.zh: 敕改給駙馬昌吉印。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the seal of imperial son-in-law Changji reissued.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the seal of imperial son-in-law Changji reissued.

sentences.zh: 修宮城、太廟、司天臺。

translations.literal: The palace city, Imperial Ancestral Temple, and Astronomical Bureau were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: The palace city, Imperial Ancestral Temple, and Astronomical Bureau were repaired.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，調軍一萬五千、馬五千匹，征也可不薛。

translations.literal: On guisi day fifteen thousand troops and five thousand horses were mobilized to campaign against Yiqibuxie.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day 15,000 troops and 5,000 horses were mobilized to campaign against Yiqibuxie.

sentences.zh: 遣使代祀嶽瀆后土。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar in the Emperor's stead.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar in the Emperor's stead.

sentences.zh: 甲午，甘州逃軍二千二百人自陳願挈家四千九百四十口還戍，敕以鈔一萬六百二十錠、布四千九百四十匹、驢四千九百四十頭給之。

translations.literal: On jiawu day two thousand two hundred deserting troops of Ganzhou presented themselves, stating they wished to bring four thousand nine hundred forty family members back to garrison duty; an edict granted them ten thousand six hundred twenty ingots, four thousand nine hundred forty bolts of cloth, and four thousand nine hundred forty donkeys.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day 2,200 deserting troops of Ganzhou came forward, saying they wished to bring 4,940 family members back to garrison duty; an edict granted them 10,620 ingots, 4,940 bolts of cloth, and 4,940 donkeys.

sentences.zh: 議征緬國，以大卜為右丞，也罕的斤為參政，領兵以行。

translations.literal: Campaigning against Burma was discussed; Da Bu was made right vice censor, Yehan Dejin associate administrator, leading troops on the expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning against Burma was discussed; Da Bu was made right vice censor and Yehan Dejin associate administrator to lead troops on the expedition.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，給別十八里元帥綦公直軍需。

translations.literal: On wuxu day military supplies were issued to commander-in-chief Qi Gongzhi at Bie Shibali.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day military supplies were issued to commander-in-chief Qi Gongzhi at Bie Shibali.

sentences.zh: 遣使往乾山，造江南戰船千艘。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to Qianshan to build one thousand Jiangnan war vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to Qianshan to build 1,000 Jiangnan war vessels.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賜諸王塔剌海籍沒五十戶，願受十二戶。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Prince Talahai was granted fifty confiscated households but accepted only twelve.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Prince Talahai was granted 50 confiscated households but accepted only 12.

sentences.zh: 孛羅歡理算未征糧二十七萬石，詔征之。

translations.literal: Boluohuan's audit found two hundred seventy thousand shi of grain not yet levied; an edict ordered it collected.
translations.idiomatic: Boluohuan's audit found 270,000 shi of grain not yet levied; an edict ordered it collected.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，升軍器監秩三品。

translations.literal: On renyin day the Armory Directorate was raised to rank three.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Armory Directorate was raised to rank three.

sentences.zh: 命軍官陣亡者，其子襲職，以疾卒者，授官降一等，具為令。

translations.literal: An order directed that when military officers fell in battle, their sons inherit the post; those who died of illness receive an office one rank lower; this was made regulation.
translations.idiomatic: An order directed that when military officers fell in battle their sons inherit the post, that those who died of illness receive an office one rank lower, and this was made regulation.

sentences.zh: 授溪洞招討使郭昂等九人虎符，仍賞張溫、顏義顯銀各千兩。

translations.literal: Tiger tallies were granted to stream-cave pacification commissioner Guo Ang and eight others; Zhang Wen and Yan Yixian were also rewarded with one thousand liang of silver each.
translations.idiomatic: Tiger tallies were granted to stream-cave pacification commissioner Guo Ang and eight others; Zhang Wen and Yan Yixian were also rewarded with 1,000 liang of silver each.

sentences.zh: 收晃兀兒塔海民匠九百五十三戶入官。

translations.literal: Nine hundred fifty-three artisan households of Huangwu'er Tahai were taken into government registration.
translations.idiomatic: 953 artisan households of Huangwu'er Tahai were taken into government registration.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，立廣東按察司。

translations.literal: On yisi day the Guangdong surveillance commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the Guangdong surveillance commission was established.

sentences.zh: 戊申，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On wushen day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 己酉，減省部官冗員。

translations.literal: On jiyou day redundant officials in the ministries were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day redundant officials in the ministries were reduced.

sentences.zh: 改上都宣課提領為宣課提舉司。

translations.literal: The Shangdu revenue collection supervisor was changed to a revenue collection commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Shangdu revenue collection supervisor was changed to a revenue collection commission.

sentences.zh: 立鐵冶總管府，罷提舉司。

translations.literal: An iron smelting commissionerate was established and the collection commission abolished.
translations.idiomatic: An iron smelting commissionerate was established and the collection commission abolished.

sentences.zh: 減大都稅課官十四員為十員。

translations.literal: Tax bureau officials of the Great Capital were reduced from fourteen to ten.
translations.idiomatic: Tax bureau officials of the Great Capital were reduced from 14 to 10.

sentences.zh: 改羅羅斯宣慰司隸雲南省，徙浙東宣慰司於溫州。

translations.literal: The Luorosi pacification commission was placed under Yunnan Province; the East Zhe pacification commission was moved to Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Luorosi pacification commission was placed under Yunnan Province; the East Zhe pacification commission was moved to Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 分軍戍守江南，自歸州以及江陰至三海口，凡二十八所。

translations.literal: Troops were divided to garrison Jiangnan from Guizhou through Jiangyin to Sanhaikou, twenty-eight posts in all.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were divided to garrison Jiangnan from Guizhou through Jiangyin to Sanhaikou, 28 posts in all.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以參知政事唐兀帶等六人，鎮守黃州、建康、江陵、池州、興國。

translations.literal: On gengxu day six associate administrators including Tang Wudai were stationed at Huangzhou, Jiankang, Jiangling, Chizhou, and Xingguo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day six associate administrators including Tang Wudai were stationed at Huangzhou, Jiankang, Jiangling, Chizhou, and Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔僉亦奚不薛及播、思、敘三州軍征緬國。

translations.literal: On renzi day an edict mustered Yixi Busi troops and the armies of Bo, Si, and Xu prefectures to campaign against Burma.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict mustered Yixi Busi troops and the armies of Bo, Si, and Xu prefectures to campaign against Burma.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大良平元帥蒲元圭遣其男世能入覲。

translations.literal: On guichou day Daliangping commander-in-chief Pu Yuangui sent his son Shineng to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Daliangping commander-in-chief Pu Yuangui sent his son Shineng to audience.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 申嚴漢人軍器之禁。

translations.literal: The prohibition on Han people's military weapons was tightened.
translations.idiomatic: The prohibition on Han people's military weapons was tightened.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，安州張拗驢以詐敕及偽為丞相孛羅署印，伏誅。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Zhang Aolü of Anzhou, for forging an edict and falsely using Chancellor Boluo's seal, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Zhang Aolü of Anzhou, for forging an edict and falsely using Chancellor Boluo's seal, was executed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賜雲南使臣及陜西簽省八八以下銀鈔、衣服有差。

translations.literal: On wuwu day silver notes and clothing in graded amounts were granted to Yunnan envoys and those below Bashiba of the Shaanxi branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day silver notes and clothing in graded amounts were granted to Yunnan envoys and those below Bashiba of the Shaanxi branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 籍福建戶數。

translations.literal: Fujian households were registered.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian households were registered.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉朔，烏蒙民叛，敕那懷、火魯思迷率蒙古、漢人新附軍討之。

translations.literal: Third month, on the xinyou new moon, Wumeng people rebelled; an edict ordered Naqun and Qorqas Timish to lead Mongol and newly submitted Han troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou new moon, Wumeng people rebelled; an edict ordered Naqun and Qorqas Timish to lead Mongol and newly submitted Han troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 賞忽都答兒等戰功牛羊馬。

translations.literal: Cattle, sheep, and horses were granted to reward the battle merit of Qutuq Dar and others.
translations.idiomatic: Cattle, sheep, and horses were granted to reward the battle merit of Qutuq Dar and others.

sentences.zh: 益都千戶王著，以阿合馬蠹國害民，與高和尚合謀殺之。

translations.literal: Yidu qianhu Wang Zhu, because Ahmad had corrupted the state and harmed the people, joined Gao Heshang in a plot to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Yidu qianhu Wang Zhu, because Ahmad had corrupted the state and harmed the people, joined Gao Heshang in a plot to kill him.

sentences.zh: 壬午，誅王著、張易、高和尚於市，皆醢之，余黨悉伏誅。

translations.literal: On renwu day Wang Zhu, Zhang Yi, and Gao Heshang were executed in the market, all pickled; remaining accomplices were entirely executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Wang Zhu, Zhang Yi, and Gao Heshang were executed in the market and their bodies pickled; all remaining accomplices were executed.

sentences.zh: 甲申，的斤帖林以己貲充屯田之費，諸王阿只吉以聞，敕酬其直。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Dejin Telin used his own funds for garrison-farm expenses; Prince Ajiji reported it; an edict compensated him at fair value.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Dejin Telin used his own funds for garrison-farm expenses; Prince Ajiji reported it; an edict compensated him at fair value.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，禁益都、東平、沿淮諸郡軍民官捕獵。

translations.literal: On bingxu day hunting by military and civilian officials of Yidu, Dongping, and commanderies along the Huai was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day hunting by military and civilian officials of Yidu, Dongping, and commanderies along the Huai was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 戊子，立塔兒八合你驛，以烏蒙阿謀歲輸騬馬給之。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Tatarbaqani Station was established, supplied annually with gelded horses from Wumeng Amu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Tatarbaqani Station was established, supplied annually with gelded horses from Wumeng Amu.

sentences.zh: 以領北庭都護阿必失哈為御史大夫，行御史臺事。

translations.literal: Beshbaligh protector-general Abishaq was made censor-in-chief, conducting branch censorate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Beshbaligh protector-general Abishaq was made censor-in-chief, conducting branch censorate affairs.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，敕和禮霍孫集中書省部、御史臺、樞密院、翰林院等官，議阿合馬所管財賦，先行封籍府庫。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinmao day, an edict ordered Huluhuosun to convene officials of the Central Secretariat and ministries, Censorate, Military Affairs Bureau, Hanlin Academy, and others to deliberate on the revenue Ahmad had managed, first sealing and registering the treasuries.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on xinmao day, an edict ordered Huluhuosun to convene officials of the Central Secretariat and ministries, Censorate, Military Affairs Bureau, Hanlin Academy, and others to deliberate on the revenue Ahmad had managed, first sealing and registering the treasuries.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以和禮霍孫為中書右丞相，降右丞相甕吉剌帶為留守，仍同僉樞密院事。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Huluhuosun was made right grand councillor of the Central Secretariat; right grand councillor Wengjiladai was demoted to capital intendant while still concurrently associated with the Military Affairs Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Huluhuosun was made right grand councillor of the Central Secretariat; right grand councillor Wengjiladai was demoted to capital intendant while still concurrently associated with the Military Affairs Bureau.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，征蠻元帥完者都等平陳吊眼巢穴班師，賞其軍鈔，仍令還家休息。

translations.literal: On wuxu day barbarian-suppression commander-in-chief Wanzhedu and others pacified Chen Diaoyan's stronghold and returned; their army was rewarded with paper currency and ordered home to rest.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day barbarian-suppression commander-in-chief Wanzhedu and others pacified Chen Diaoyan's stronghold and returned; their army was rewarded with paper currency and ordered home to rest.

sentences.zh: 遣揚州射士戍泉州。

translations.literal: Yangzhou archers were dispatched to garrison Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhou archers were dispatched to garrison Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 陳吊眼父文桂及兄弟桂龍、滿安納款，命護送赴京師。

translations.literal: Chen Diaoyan's father Wen Gui and his brothers Guilong and Man'an submitted; an order directed them escorted to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Diaoyan's father Wen Gui and his brothers Guilong and Man'an submitted; an order directed them escorted to the capital.

sentences.zh: 其黨吳滿、張飛迎敵，就誅之。

translations.literal: His followers Wu Man and Zhang Fei welcomed the enemy and were executed on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: His followers Wu Man and Zhang Fei welcomed the enemy and were executed on the spot.

sentences.zh: 敕以大都巡軍隸留守司。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Dadu patrol troops placed under the capital intendant's office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Dadu patrol troops placed under the capital intendant's office.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，立回易庫。

translations.literal: On renyin day an exchange treasury was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an exchange treasury was established.

sentences.zh: 中書左丞耿仁等言：「諸王公主分地所設達魯花赤，例不遷調，百姓苦之。

translations.literal: Left vice chancellor Geng Ren and others said: "The darughachis established on princes' and princesses' allotted fiefs are by precedent not transferred, to the people's hardship.
translations.idiomatic: Left vice chancellor Geng Ren and others said, "The darughachis established on princes' and princesses' allotted fiefs are by precedent not transferred, to the people's hardship.

sentences.zh: 依常調，任滿，從本位下選代為宜。

translations.literal: Following regular transfer, upon completing a term, replacements should be selected from their original rank; this would be appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Following regular transfer, upon completing a term, replacements should be selected from their original rank; this would be appropriate.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 以留守司兼行工部。

translations.literal: The capital intendant's office was also placed in charge of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: The capital intendant's office was also placed in charge of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 敕自今歲用官車，勿賦於民，可即灤河造之，給其糧費。

translations.literal: An edict directed that from this year official carts not be levied on the people; they could be built promptly on the Luan River, with grain costs supplied.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that from this year official carts not be levied on the people; they could be built promptly on the Luan River, with grain costs supplied.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以甘州、中興屯田兵逃還太原，誅其拒命者四人，而賞不逃者。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Ganzhou and Zhongxing garrison-farm troops who had deserted returned to Taiyuan; four who resisted orders were executed and those who did not desert were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Ganzhou and Zhongxing garrison-farm troops who had deserted returned to Taiyuan; four who resisted orders were executed and those who did not desert were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以阿合馬家奴忽都答兒等久總兵權，令博敦等代之，仍隸大都留守司。

translations.literal: On yisi day because Ahmad's household slaves Qutuq Dar and others had long held military authority, Bodun and others were ordered to replace them, still subordinate to the Dadu capital intendant's office.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day because Ahmad's household slaves Qutuq Dar and others had long held military authority, Bodun and others were ordered to replace them, still subordinate to the Dadu capital intendant's office.

sentences.zh: 弛西山薪炭禁。

translations.literal: The prohibition on fuelwood and charcoal from the Western Hills was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: The prohibition on fuelwood and charcoal from the Western Hills was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 以阿合馬之子江淮行中書省平章政事忽辛罪重於父，議究勘之。

translations.literal: Because Ahmad's son Husin, left associate of the Jianghuai branch secretariat, was guiltier than his father, investigation was discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Because Ahmad's son Husin, left associate of the Jianghuai branch secretariat, was guiltier than his father, investigation was discussed.

sentences.zh: 考核諸處平準庫，汰倉庫官。

translations.literal: Stabilization treasuries everywhere were audited and warehouse officials cut.
translations.idiomatic: Stabilization treasuries everywhere were audited and warehouse officials cut.

sentences.zh: 御史臺臣言：「見在贓罰鈔三萬錠，金銀、珠玉、幣帛稱是。

translations.literal: Censorate officials said: "Confiscated fines amount to thirty thousand ingots of paper currency, with gold, silver, pearls, jade, and silks commensurate.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Confiscated fines amount to 30,000 ingots of paper currency, with gold, silver, pearls, jade, and silks commensurate.

sentences.zh: 」詔留以給貧乏者。

translations.literal: " An edict directed these retained to supply the impoverished.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict directed these retained to supply the impoverished.

sentences.zh: 丙午，收諸王別帖木兒總軍銀印。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the overall army silver seal of Prince Betemür was collected.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the overall army silver seal of Prince Betemür was collected.

sentences.zh: 敕也裏可溫依僧例給糧。

translations.literal: An edict directed Nestorian Christians receive grain rations by the monk precedent.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed Nestorian Christians receive grain rations by the monk precedent.

translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Ningguo Circuit Taiping County suffered famine; the people gathered bamboo seeds for food, and more than 300 households survived.

sentences.zh: 敕出使人還，不即以所給符上，與上而有司不即收者，皆罪之。

translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that when envoys returned from missions, if they did not promptly turn in the travel tallies they had been given, or turned them in but officials did not promptly receive them, all were to be punished.

sentences.zh: 凡文書並奏可始用御寶。

translations.idiomatic: All documents required memorial approval before the imperial seal could be used.

sentences.zh: 己酉，刊行蒙古畏吾兒字所書《通鑒》。

translations.literal: On jiyou day the 《Zizhi Tongjian》 written in Mongol and Uighur script was published.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the 《Zizhi Tongjian》 written in Mongol and Uighur script was published.

sentences.zh: 以和禮霍孫為右丞相詔天下。

translations.literal: An edict announced Huluhuosun as right grand councillor to the empire.
translations.idiomatic: An edict announced Huluhuosun as right grand councillor to the empire.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，行御史臺言：「阿裏海牙占降民為奴，而以為征討所得。

translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the branch censorate said, "Ala Haiya took submitted people as slaves and claimed them as booty from campaigns.

translations.idiomatic: " An order directed submitted people returned to the responsible offices; booty from campaigns was to be registered by quantity and granted to meritorious subjects.

sentences.zh: 以興兵問罪海外，天下供給繁重，詔慰諭軍民，應有逋欠錢糧及官吏侵盜並權停罷。

translations.literal: Because raising troops to punish overseas states made empire-wide supply heavy, an edict comforted troops and people; all overdue money and grain and official embezzlement were temporarily suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Because raising troops to punish overseas states made empire-wide supply heavy, an edict comforted troops and people; all overdue money and grain and official embezzlement were temporarily suspended.

sentences.zh: 設懷孟路管河渠使、副各一員。

translations.literal: Huai-Meng Route river conservancy director and deputy, one each, were established.
translations.idiomatic: Huai-Meng Route river conservancy director and deputy, one each, were established.

sentences.zh: 拘括江南官豪隱匿逃軍。

translations.literal: Jiangnan powerful families concealing deserters were rounded up.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan powerful families concealing deserters were rounded up.

sentences.zh: 壬子，罷江南諸司自給驛券。

translations.literal: On renzi day Jiangnan bureaus' self-issued relay vouchers were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Jiangnan bureaus' self-issued relay vouchers were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，敕以妻女姊妹獻阿合馬得仕者，黜之。

translations.literal: On bingchen day an edict directed dismissal of those who gained office by offering wives, daughters, or sisters to Ahmad.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict directed dismissal of those who gained office by offering wives, daughters, or sisters to Ahmad.

sentences.zh: 核阿合馬占據民田，給還其主；

translations.literal: Ahmad's seized commoners' fields were returned to their owners;
translations.idiomatic: Ahmad's seized commoners' fields were returned to their owners;

sentences.zh: 庇富強戶輸賦其家者，仍輸之官。

translations.literal: those protected by powerful households who paid taxes at those households were still to pay to the government.
translations.idiomatic: those protected by powerful households who paid taxes at those households were still to pay to the government.

sentences.zh: 北京宣慰使阿老瓦丁濫舉非才為管民官，命選官代之。

translations.literal: Beijing pacification commissioner Alawadin had indiscriminately promoted unqualified persons as civilian administrators; an order directed replacement officials selected.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing pacification commissioner Alawadin had indiscriminately promoted unqualified persons as civilian administrators; an order directed replacement officials selected.

sentences.zh: 議設鹽使司賣鹽引法，擇利民者行之，仍令按察司磨刷運司文卷。

translations.literal: Establishing salt transport offices to sell salt certificates was discussed; the method benefiting the people was to be chosen and implemented; surveillance commissions were still directed to audit transport office documents.
translations.idiomatic: Establishing salt transport offices to sell salt certificates was discussed; the method benefiting the people was to be chosen and implemented, and surveillance commissions were still directed to audit transport office documents.

sentences.zh: 定民間貸錢取息之法，以三分為率。

translations.literal: The law for private moneylending interest was fixed at three percent.
translations.idiomatic: The law for private moneylending interest was fixed at three percent.

sentences.zh: 定內外官以三年為考，滿任者遷敘，未滿者不許超遷。

translations.literal: It was fixed that officials within and without be examined on a three-year cycle; those completing a term were transferred and ranked, those not completing a term were not permitted extraordinary promotion.
translations.idiomatic: It was fixed that officials within and without be examined on a three-year cycle; those completing a term were transferred and ranked, and those not completing a term were not permitted extraordinary promotion.

sentences.zh: 禁吐蕃僧給驛太繁，擾害於民，自今非奉旨勿給。

translations.literal: Tibetan monks receiving relay passes too frequently, troubling the people, was forbidden; from now on none were to be granted except by imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan monks receiving relay passes too frequently and troubling the people was forbidden; from now on none were to be granted except by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 給控鶴人鈔一萬五錠，及其官吏有差。

translations.literal: Fifteen thousand ingots were granted to the Crane Controllers, and their officials in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: 15,000 ingots were granted to the Crane Controllers, and their officials in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 五月己未朔，鉤考萬億庫及南京宣慰司。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on the jiwei new moon, the Wan'yi Treasury and Nanjing pacification commission were audited.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiwei new moon, the Wan'yi Treasury and Nanjing pacification commission were audited.

sentences.zh: 沙汰省部官，阿合馬黨人七百十四人，已革者三十三人，余五百八十一人並黜之。

translations.literal: Secretariat and ministry officials were purged; seven hundred fourteen of Ahmad's faction were found, thirty-three already dismissed, the remaining five hundred eighty-one all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat and ministry officials were purged; 714 of Ahmad's faction were found, 33 already dismissed, and the remaining 581 all dismissed.

sentences.zh: 瀘州管軍總管李從，坐受軍士賄縱其私還，致萬戶爪難等為賊所殺，伏誅。

translations.literal: Luzhou military commander Li Cong, for accepting bribes from soldiers and letting them return privately, causing wanhu Zhuanan and others to be killed by bandits, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Luzhou military commander Li Cong, for accepting bribes from soldiers and letting them return privately, causing wanhu Zhuanan and others to be killed by bandits, was executed.

sentences.zh: 籍阿合馬馬駝牛羊驢等三千七百五十八，追治阿合馬罪，剖棺戮其屍於通玄門外。

translations.literal: Three thousand seven hundred fifty-eight horses, camels, cattle, sheep, and donkeys of Ahmad were registered; Ahmad's crimes were pursued, his coffin opened and his corpse exposed at the outside of the Tongxuan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: 3,758 horses, camels, cattle, sheep, and donkeys belonging to Ahmad were registered; Ahmad's crimes were pursued, his coffin opened, and his corpse exposed outside the Tongxuan Gate.

sentences.zh: 罷南京宣慰司及江南財賦總管府。

translations.literal: The Nanjing pacification commission and Jiangnan revenue commissionerate were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanjing pacification commission and Jiangnan revenue commissionerate were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，降各省給驛璽書。

translations.literal: On dingmao day an edict was issued to the provinces regarding relay seal documents.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict was issued to the provinces regarding relay seal documents.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，並江西、福建行省，去江南冗濫官，免福建山縣鎮店宣課，禁當路私人權府、州、司、縣官。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the Jiangxi and Fujian branch secretariats were merged, redundant Jiangnan officials were cut, commercial levies on Fujian mountain counties and market towns were remitted, and private persons on the routes usurping control of prefecture, zhou, bureau, and county offices were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Jiangxi and Fujian branch secretariats were merged, redundant Jiangnan officials were cut, commercial levies on Fujian mountain counties and market towns were remitted, and private persons on the routes usurping control of prefecture, zhou, bureau, and county offices were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 招諭畬洞人，免其罪。

translations.literal: The She cave people were summoned to submit and their crimes remitted.
translations.idiomatic: The She cave people were summoned to submit and their crimes remitted.

sentences.zh: 禁差戍軍防送。

translations.literal: The practice of detailing garrison troops for prisoner escort was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The practice of detailing garrison troops for prisoner escort was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 禁人匠提舉擅招匠戶。

translations.literal: Craft commissioners were forbidden to recruit artisan households on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: Craft commissioners were forbidden to recruit artisan households on their own authority.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣浙西道宣慰司同知劉宣等理算各鹽運司及財賦府茶場都轉運司出納之數。

translations.literal: On jisi day Liu Xuan, associate commissioner of the Zhexi Route pacification commission, and others were dispatched to audit receipts and disbursements of each salt transport commission and the tea transport bureaus of the revenue offices.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Liu Xuan, associate commissioner of the Zhexi Route pacification commission, and others were sent to audit receipts and disbursements of each salt transport commission and the tea transport bureaus of the revenue offices.

sentences.zh: 籍阿合馬妻子親屬所營資產，其奴婢縱之為民。

translations.literal: The assets operated by Ahmad's wife, children, and kin were registered, and their slaves were released as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: The assets operated by Ahmad's wife, children, and kin were registered, and their slaves were released as commoners.

sentences.zh: 罷宣慰使所帶相銜。

translations.literal: The concurrent ranks attached to pacification commissioners were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The concurrent ranks attached to pacification commissioners were abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬申，鎖系耿仁至大都，命中書省鞫之。

translations.literal: On renshen day Geng Ren was shackled and brought to Dadu; the Central Secretariat was ordered to try him.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Geng Ren was shackled and brought to Dadu; the Central Secretariat was ordered to try him.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，議於平灤州造船，發軍民合九千人，令探馬赤伯要帶領之，伐木於山，及取於寺觀墳墓，官酬其直，仍命桑哥遣人督之。

translations.literal: On gengchen day deliberation was held on building ships at Pingluan Prefecture; nine thousand troops and civilians combined were mobilized, with temechi Bieyadai placed in command to cut timber in the mountains and also take it from temples, monasteries, and graves, the state paying fair value; Sangge was also ordered to send men to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day deliberation was held on building ships at Pingluan Prefecture; 9,000 troops and civilians combined were mobilized, with temechi Bieyadai placed in command to cut timber in the mountains and also take it from temples, monasteries, and graves, the state paying fair value; Sangge was also ordered to send men to supervise.

sentences.zh: 癸未，給大都拔都兒正軍夏衣。

translations.literal: On guiwei day summer clothing was issued to the Dadu Badu'er regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day summer clothing was issued to the Dadu Badu'er regular troops.

sentences.zh: 和禮霍孫言：「省部濫官七百十四員，其無過者五百八十一員姑存之。

translations.literal: Huluhuosun said: "Among the seven hundred fourteen superfluous officials in the secretariat and ministries, five hundred eighty-one without fault may temporarily be retained.
translations.idiomatic: Huluhuosun said, "Among the 714 superfluous officials in the secretariat and ministries, 581 without fault may temporarily be retained.

sentences.zh: 」沿海左副都元帥石國英請以稅戶贍軍，軍逃死者，令其補足；

translations.idiomatic: " Left associate coastal commander-in-chief Shi Guoying asked that tax households support the army, with those whose soldiers deserted or died required to make up the numbers;

translations.literal: relay household seed tax, where rich and poor were uneven, their corvée should be equalized.
translations.idiomatic: relay household seed tax, where rich and poor were uneven, should be equalized.

sentences.zh: 又請行鹽法，汰官吏，罷捕戶。

translations.literal: He also asked to implement the salt law, cut officials, and abolish hunting households.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to implement the salt law, cut officials, and abolish hunting households.

sentences.zh: 詔中書集議行之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Central Secretariat to deliberate and implement these measures.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Central Secretariat to deliberate and implement these measures.

sentences.zh: 張惠、阿裏罷。

translations.literal: Zhang Hui and Ali were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hui and Ali were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以甘肅行省左丞麥術丁為中書右丞，行御史臺御史中丞張雄飛參知政事。

translations.idiomatic: Gansu branch secretariat left vice minister Maitingding was made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and branch censorate censor-in-chief Zhang Xiongfei was made associate administrator.

translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day commander-in-chief Qi Gongzhi said, "I ask that deserters be branded and still made to serve in the army, and that smelting works be established at Bie Shibali to cast farm implements.

translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted.

translations.literal: On bingxu day locusts three hundred li east of Bie Shibali destroyed the wheat crop.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day locusts 300 li east of Bie Shibali destroyed the wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on the jichou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jichou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 芝生眉州。

translations.literal: Auspicious fungus appeared in Meizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious fungus appeared in Meizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，阿合馬濫設官府二百四所，詔存者三十三，餘皆罷。

translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Ahmad had arbitrarily established 204 offices; an edict retained 33 and abolished the rest.

translations.idiomatic: Of the 15 Jiangnan pacification commissions, four that already had branch secretariats were abolished.

translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day 770 garrison-farm troops from Liupan Mountain were dispatched to fill out Liu En's army.

translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade pacification commissioners and other officials to employ regular troops as corvée.

sentences.zh: 丙申，發射士百人衛丞相，他人不得援例。

translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day 100 archers were dispatched to guard the chancellor; others were not permitted to cite this as precedent.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以占城既服復叛，發淮、浙、福建、湖廣軍五千、海船百艘、戰船二百五十，命唆都為將討之。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, because Champa had submitted and then rebelled again, five thousand troops from Huai, Zhe, Fujian, and Huguang, one hundred sea ships, and two hundred fifty war vessels were dispatched, with Suodu placed in command to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, because Champa had submitted and then rebelled again, 5,000 troops from Huai, Zhe, Fujian, and Huguang, 100 sea ships, and 250 war vessels were dispatched under Suodu to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 亡宋軍有手號及無手號者，並聽為民。

translations.literal: Former Song troops, whether with hand marks or without hand marks, were all permitted to become civilians.
translations.idiomatic: Former Song troops, whether with hand marks or without, were all permitted to become civilians.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命何子誌為管軍萬戶，使暹國。

translations.literal: On jihai day He Zizhi was made army-commanding wanhu and sent as envoy to Siam.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day He Zizhi was made army-commanding wanhu and sent as envoy to Siam.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，籍阿合馬妻子婿奴婢財產。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the property of Ahmad's wife, children, sons-in-law, and slaves was registered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the property of Ahmad's wife, children, sons-in-law, and slaves was registered.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，禁濫保軍功。

translations.literal: On guimao day the indiscriminate certification of battle merit was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the indiscriminate certification of battle merit was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，招無籍軍給衣糧。

translations.literal: On yisi day unregistered troops were recruited and given clothing and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day unregistered troops were recruited and given clothing and grain.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賞太子府宿衛軍禦盜之功，給鈔、馬有差，無妻者以沒官寡婦配之。

translations.literal: On jiyou day the crown prince's household guard troops were rewarded for merit in repelling thieves, granted paper currency and horses in graded amounts, and those without wives were matched with confiscated widows.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the crown prince's household guard troops were rewarded for repelling thieves, granted paper currency and horses in graded amounts, and those without wives were matched with confiscated widows.

sentences.zh: 以阿合馬居第賜和禮霍孫。

translations.literal: Ahmad's residence was granted to Huluhuosun.
translations.idiomatic: Ahmad's residence was granted to Huluhuosun.

sentences.zh: 壬子，申敕中外百官立限決事。

translations.literal: On renzi day an edict ordered all officials within and without to decide cases within fixed time limits.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict ordered all officials within and without to decide cases within fixed time limits.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，從和禮霍孫言，罷司徒府及農政院。

translations.literal: On guichou day, following Huluhuosun's recommendation, the Minister of Education's office and the Agriculture Directorate were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, following Huluhuosun's recommendation, the Minister of Education's office and the Agriculture Directorate were abolished.

sentences.zh: 鎖系忽辛赴揚州鞫治。

translations.literal: Husin was shackled and sent to Yangzhou for trial.
translations.idiomatic: Husin was shackled and sent to Yangzhou for trial.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，征亦奚不薛，盡平其地，立三路達魯花赤，留軍鎮守，命藥剌海總之，以也速帶兒為都元帥宣慰使。

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Yixibuxue was attacked and his territory entirely pacified; three-route darughachis were established, garrison troops were left to hold it, Yarlaq Hai was ordered to command overall, and Yesudai'er was made grand commander and pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the wuwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the wuwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 立行樞密院於揚州、鄂州。

translations.literal: Mobile privy councils were established at Yangzhou and Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Mobile privy councils were established at Yangzhou and Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命行御史臺揀汰各道按察司官。

translations.literal: On gengshen day the Branch Censorate was ordered to weed out surveillance commission officials on each route.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the branch censorate was ordered to weed out surveillance commission officials on each route.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，剖郝禎棺，戮其屍。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Hao Zhen's coffin was opened and his corpse exposed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Hao Zhen's coffin was opened and his corpse exposed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命以官錢給戍軍費，而以各奧魯所征還官。

translations.literal: On renxu day an order directed that official funds supply garrison expenses, while the levies collected by each orlu office were to be returned to the state.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day an order directed that official funds supply garrison expenses, while levies collected by each orlu office were to be returned to the state.

sentences.zh: 禁諸位下營運錢貨差軍護送。

translations.literal: Princes and others were forbidden to employ corvée troops to escort money and goods they operated for profit.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and others were forbidden to employ corvée troops to escort money and goods they operated for profit.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王請自造船一百五十艘，助征日本。

translations.literal: The king of Goryeo asked to build one hundred fifty ships himself to assist in the campaign against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Goryeo asked to build 150 ships himself to assist in the campaign against Japan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，征鴨池回軍屯田安西，以鈔給之。

translations.literal: On wuchen day troops returning from the Yachi campaign were ordered to garrison-farm in Anxi and were granted paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day troops returning from the Yachi campaign were ordered to garrison-farm in Anxi and were granted paper currency.

sentences.zh: 庚午，令蒙古軍守江南者更番還家。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Mongol troops garrisoning Jiangnan were ordered to rotate home in turns.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Mongol troops garrisoning Jiangnan were ordered to rotate home in turns.

sentences.zh: 壬申，發察罕腦兒軍千人治晉山道。

translations.literal: On renshen day one thousand troops from Chaghan Na'ur were dispatched to repair the Jinshan road.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day 1,000 troops from Chaghan Na'ur were dispatched to repair the Jinshan road.

sentences.zh: 立馬湖路總管府。

translations.literal: The Ma Hu Route general administration was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Ma Hu Route general administration was established.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賜高麗王王春金印。

translations.literal: On guiyou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was granted a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，宣慰孟慶元、萬戶孫勝夫使瓜哇回，為忙古帶所囚，詔釋之。

translations.literal: On guiyou day pacification commissioner Meng Qingyuan and wanhu Sun Shengfu, returning as envoys from Java, were imprisoned by Mangudai; an edict ordered them released.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day pacification commissioner Meng Qingyuan and wanhu Sun Shengfu, returning as envoys from Java, were imprisoned by Mangudai; an edict ordered them released.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，罷汪劄剌兒帶總帥，收其制命、虎符。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Wang Zha'er, chief commander, was dismissed and his patent of appointment and tiger tally were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day chief commander Wang Zha'er was dismissed and his patent of appointment and tiger tally were confiscated.

sentences.zh: 以鞏昌路達魯花赤別速帖木兒為鞏昌平涼等處二十四處軍前便宜都總帥府達魯花赤。

translations.literal: Gongchang Route darughachi Biesu Temür was made darughachi of the Gongchang-Pingliang and twenty-three other places field headquarters for military convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchang Route darughachi Biesu Temür was made darughachi of the Gongchang-Pingliang and 23 other places field headquarters for military convenience.

sentences.zh: 以蒙古人孛羅領湖北辰、沅等州淘金事。

translations.literal: The Mongol Boluo was placed in charge of gold-washing in Chen, Yuan, and other prefectures of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol Boluo was placed in charge of gold-washing in Chen, Yuan, and other prefectures of Hubei.

translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day deliberation was held on building the Ashadabusu imperial city; the Privy Council said, "It would require 120,000 timbers, and the distance makes them hard to obtain; it would be better to build earthen walls as at Chaghan Na'ur.

translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was granted.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賜諸王塔海帖木兒、忽都帖木兒等金銀、幣帛有差。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Princes Tahai Temür, Hudutemür, and others were granted gold, silver, and fabrics in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day princes Tahai Temür, Hudutemür, and others received gold, silver, and fabrics in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 阇婆國貢金佛塔。

translations.literal: Java sent tribute of a gold pagoda.
translations.idiomatic: Java sent tribute of a gold pagoda.

sentences.zh: 發米賑乞裏吉思貧民。

translations.literal: Grain was issued in relief to the poor among the Kirghiz.
translations.idiomatic: Grain was issued in relief to the poor among the Kirghiz.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥朔，給乾山造船軍匠冬衣，及新附軍鈔。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on the dinghai new moon, winter clothing was issued to shipbuilding craftsmen at Qianshan, and paper currency to newly submitted troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dinghai new moon, winter clothing was issued to shipbuilding craftsmen at Qianshan, and paper currency to newly submitted troops.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，忙古帶征羅氏鬼國還，仍佩虎符，為管軍萬戶。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Mangudai returned from campaigning against Luoshi Ghost Country, still wore a tiger tally, and was made army-commanding wanhu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Mangudai returned from campaigning against Luoshi Ghost Country, still wore a tiger tally, and was made army-commanding wanhu.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以阿八赤督運糧。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Abaqchi was ordered to supervise grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Abaqchi was ordered to supervise grain transport.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，發羅羅斯等軍助征緬國。

translations.literal: On guisi day Luorosi and other troops were dispatched to assist in the campaign against Burma.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Luorosi and other troops were dispatched to assist in the campaign against Burma.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，並淄萊路田、索二鎮，仍於驛臺立新城縣治。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the Tian and Suo stockades of Zilai Route were merged, and a new Xincheng County seat was established at Yitai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Tian and Suo stockades of Zilai Route were merged, and a new Xincheng County seat was established at Yitai.

sentences.zh: 大駕駐蹕龍虎臺。

translations.literal: The imperial procession halted at Longhu Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial procession halted at Longhu Terrace.

sentences.zh: 江南水，民饑者眾；

translations.literal: Flooding in Jiangnan left many people starving;
translations.idiomatic: Flooding in Jiangnan left many people starving;

sentences.zh: 真定以南旱，民多流移；

translations.literal: south of Zhending drought drove many people to flee;
translations.idiomatic: south of Zhending drought drove many people to flee;

sentences.zh: 和禮霍孫請所在官司發廩以賑，從之。

translations.literal: Huluhuosun asked that local offices open granaries for relief; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Huluhuosun asked that local offices open granaries for relief; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 申嚴以金飾車馬服御之禁。

translations.literal: The prohibition on gilding carriages, horses, and apparel was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: The prohibition on gilding carriages, horses, and apparel was strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 又禁諸監官不得令人匠私造器物。

translations.literal: Directorate officials were also forbidden to have artisans privately make utensils.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate officials were also forbidden to have artisans privately make utensils.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，聖誕節，是日還宮。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, the Emperor's birthday, the court returned to the palace that day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the emperor's birthday, the court returned to the palace that day.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，禦正殿，受皇太子、諸王、百官朝賀。

translations.literal: On yimao day the Emperor held court in the main hall and received New Year's greetings from the crown prince, princes, and all officials.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the emperor held court in the main hall and received New Year's greetings from the crown prince, princes, and all officials.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，謫捏兀叠納戍占城以贖罪。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Nie'udienn was banished to garrison Champa to redeem his crime.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Nie'udienn was banished to garrison Champa to redeem his crime.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳朔，賑真定饑民，其流移江南者，官給之糧，使還鄉里。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on the dingsi new moon, starving people in Zhending were relieved; those who had fled to Jiangnan were given grain by the state to return home.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dingsi new moon, starving people in Zhending were relieved; those who had fled to Jiangnan were given grain by the state to return home.

sentences.zh: 敕中書省窮治阿合馬之黨。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Central Secretariat to thoroughly investigate Ahmad's faction.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Central Secretariat to thoroughly investigate Ahmad's faction.

sentences.zh: 別速帶請於羅卜、阇裏輝立驛，從之。

translations.literal: Biesudai asked to establish relay stations at Luobo and Zhelihui; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Biesudai asked to establish relay stations at Luobo and Zhelihui; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 以阿合馬沒官田產充屯田，籍阿裏家。

translations.literal: Ahmad's confiscated fields were made garrison farms, and Ali's household was registered.
translations.idiomatic: Ahmad's confiscated fields were made garrison farms, and Ali's household was registered.

sentences.zh: 戊午，誅阿合馬第三子阿散，仍剝其皮以徇。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Ahmad's third son Asan was executed, and his skin was flayed as a public warning.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Ahmad's third son Asan was executed, and his skin was flayed as a public warning.

sentences.zh: 庚申，汰冗官。

translations.literal: On gengshen day redundant officials were cut.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day redundant officials were cut.

sentences.zh: 遊顯乞罷漣、海州屯田，以其事隸管民官，從其請，仍以顯平章政事，行省揚州。

translations.literal: You Xian asked to abolish the Lian and Haizhou garrison farms and place their affairs under civilian officials; his request was granted, and You Xian was additionally made grand councillor and sent to administer the branch secretariat at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: You Xian asked to abolish the Lian and Haizhou garrison farms and place their affairs under civilian officials; his request was granted, and You Xian was additionally made grand councillor and sent to administer the branch secretariat at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 福建宣慰司獲倭國諜者，有旨留之。

translations.literal: The Fujian pacification commission captured a Japanese spy; an edict ordered him detained.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian pacification commission captured a Japanese spy; an edict ordered him detained.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，誅耿仁、撒都魯丁及阿合馬第四子忻都。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Geng Ren, Sadurudin, and Ahmad's fourth son Xindu were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Geng Ren, Sadurudin, and Ahmad's fourth son Xindu were executed.

sentences.zh: 招討使楊庭堅招撫海外，南番皆遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Campaign commissioner Yang Tingjian won over the overseas countries, and the southern fan all dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Campaign commissioner Yang Tingjian won over the overseas countries, and the southern fan all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 俱藍國主遣使奉表，進寶貨、黑猿一。

translations.literal: The lord of Jolan sent envoys with a memorial, presenting precious objects and one black ape.
translations.idiomatic: The lord of Jolan sent envoys with a memorial, presenting precious objects and one black ape.

sentences.zh: 那旺國主忙昂，以其國無識字者，遣使四人，不奉表。

translations.literal: The lord of Nawan, Mang'ang, because his country had no literate persons, dispatched four envoys without presenting a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The lord of Nawan, Mang'ang, because his country had no literate persons, sent four envoys without presenting a memorial.

sentences.zh: 蘇木都速國主土漢八的亦遣使二人。

translations.literal: The lord of Sumudusu also dispatched two envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The lord of Sumudusu also sent two envoys.

sentences.zh: 蘇木達國相臣那裏八合剌攤赤，因事在俱藍國，聞詔，代其主打古兒遣使奉表，進指環、印花綺段及錦衾二十合。

translations.literal: Sumuda chancellor Nali Bahala Tanchi, being in Jolan on business, on hearing the edict sent envoys in place of his lord Dagur with a memorial, presenting rings, printed brocade, and twenty sets of brocade quilts.
translations.idiomatic: Sumuda chancellor Nali Bahala Tanchi, being in Jolan on business, on hearing the edict sent envoys in place of his lord Dagur with a memorial, presenting rings, printed brocade, and 20 sets of brocade quilts.

sentences.zh: 寓俱藍國也裏可溫主兀咱兒撇裏馬亦遣使奉表，進七寶項牌一、藥物二瓶。

translations.literal: The Nestorian chief residing in Jolan, Wuzan'er Pielima, also sent envoys with a memorial, presenting one seven-jewel neck plaque and two bottles of medicine.
translations.idiomatic: The Nestorian chief residing in Jolan, Wuzan'er Pielima, also sent envoys with a memorial, presenting one seven-jewel neck plaque and two bottles of medicine.

sentences.zh: 又管領木速蠻馬合馬亦遣使奉表，同日赴闕。

translations.literal: Mahama, overseer of the Musuman, also sent envoys with a memorial, arriving at court the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Mahama, overseer of the Musuman, also sent envoys with a memorial, arriving at court the same day.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，禁諸人不得沮撓課程。

translations.literal: On renxu day all persons were forbidden to obstruct tax collection.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day all persons were forbidden to obstruct tax collection.

sentences.zh: 敕：「官吏受賄及倉庫官侵盜，臺察官知而不糾者，驗其輕重罪之。

translations.literal: An edict: "Officials who accept bribes and granary officials who embezzle, if surveillance officials know but do not impeach, shall be punished according to the gravity of the offense.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered: "Officials who accept bribes and granary officials who embezzle, if surveillance officials know but do not impeach, shall be punished according to the gravity of the offense.

sentences.zh: 中外官吏贓罪，輕者杖決，重者處死。

translations.literal: Officials within and without who commit corruption, the lighter cases shall be beaten and decided, the heavier shall be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Officials within and without who commit corruption: lighter cases shall be beaten and decided, heavier cases shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 言官緘默，與受贓者一體論罪。

translations.literal: Remonstrating officials who keep silent shall be punished as one with those who accept bribes.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrating officials who keep silent shall be punished the same as those who accept bribes.

translations.idiomatic: " An edict was also issued proclaiming this throughout the realm.
