translations.literal: On yichou day troops were levied in Yixibuxue and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day troops were levied in Yixibuxue and other places.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，安南國進貢犀兕、金銀器、香藥等物。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Annam sent tribute of rhinoceros, elephants, gold and silver vessels, incense, and medicines.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Annam sent tribute of rhinoceros, elephants, gold and silver vessels, incense, and medicines.

sentences.zh: 增給元帥綦公直軍冬衣鈔。

translations.literal: Additional winter-clothing paper currency was granted to the army of commander-in-chief Qi Gongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Additional winter-clothing paper currency was granted to the army of commander-in-chief Qi Gongzhi.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命軍站戶出錢助民和顧和買。

translations.literal: On jisi day military relay households were ordered to contribute money to assist the people's corvée purchases and labor hires.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day military relay households were ordered to contribute money to assist the people's corvée purchases and labor hires.

sentences.zh: 籍雲南新附戶。

translations.literal: Newly submitted households of Yunnan were registered.
translations.idiomatic: Newly submitted households in Yunnan were registered.

sentences.zh: 自兀良合帶鎮雲南，凡八籍民戶，四籍民田，民以為病。

translations.literal: Since Uriangqadai garrisoned Yunnan, household rolls had been taken eight times and land rolls four times; the people regarded this as a hardship.
translations.idiomatic: Since Uriangqadai garrisoned Yunnan, household rolls had been taken eight times and land rolls four times, and the people found it oppressive.

sentences.zh: 至是，令已籍者勿動，新附者籍之。

translations.literal: At this time it was ordered that those already registered not be disturbed and only the newly submitted be registered.
translations.idiomatic: At this time it was ordered that those already registered be left alone and only the newly submitted registered.

sentences.zh: 定雲南稅賦用金為則，以貝子折納，每金一錢直貝子二十索。

translations.literal: Yunnan taxes and levies were fixed with gold as the standard, payable in cowrie shells at twenty strings per mace of gold.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan taxes and levies were fixed with gold as the standard, payable in cowrie shells at twenty strings per mace of gold.

sentences.zh: 罷雲南宣慰司。

translations.literal: The Yunnan pacification commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan pacification commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬申，敕平灤、高麗、耽羅及揚州、隆興、泉州共造大小船三千艘。

translations.literal: On renshen day an edict ordered Pingluan, Goryeo, Tamna, Yangzhou, Longxing, and Quanzhou jointly to build three thousand large and small ships.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day an edict ordered Pingluan, Goryeo, Tamna, Yangzhou, Longxing, and Quanzhou jointly to build three thousand large and small ships.

sentences.zh: 亦奚不薛之北，蠻洞向世雄兄弟及散毛諸洞叛，命四川行省就遣亦奚不薛軍前往招撫之，使與其主偕來。

translations.literal: North of Yixi Busi, Xiang Shixiong and his brothers of Man Cave and the various caves of Sanmao rebelled; the Sichuan Branch Secretariat was ordered to dispatch Yixi Busi troops to pacify them and have them come together with their lord.
translations.idiomatic: North of Yixi Busi, Xiang Shixiong and his brothers of Man Cave and the various Sanmao caves rebelled; the Sichuan branch secretariat was ordered to send Yixi Busi troops to pacify them and bring them in with their lord.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，阿合馬侄宰奴丁伏誅。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Ahmad's nephew Zainuding was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Ahmad's nephew Zainuding was executed.

sentences.zh: 罷忽辛黨馬璘江淮行省參知政事。

translations.literal: Ma Lin of Husin's faction was dismissed as left associate of the Jianghuai Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Lin of Husin's faction was dismissed as left associate of the Jianghuai branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，遣使括雲南所產金，以孛羅為打金洞達魯花赤。

translations.literal: On dinghai day envoys were dispatched to register gold produced in Yunnan; Boluo was made darughachi of the gold-mining district.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day envoys were sent to register gold produced in Yunnan; Boluo was made darughachi of the gold-mining district.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，給新附軍賈祐衣糧。

translations.literal: On wuyin day clothing and grain were issued to the newly submitted soldier Jia You.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day clothing and grain were issued to the newly submitted soldier Jia You.

sentences.zh: 祐言為日本國焦元帥婿，知江南造船，遣其來候動靜，軍馬壓境，願先降附。

translations.literal: You said he was the son-in-law of Marshal Jiao of Japan, knew about shipbuilding in Jiangnan, and had been sent to observe conditions; with the army pressing the border, he wished to submit first.
translations.idiomatic: You said he was the son-in-law of Marshal Jiao of Japan, knew Jiangnan shipbuilding, and had been sent to watch developments; with the army at the border, he wished to submit first.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，敕各行省止用印一，余者拘之，及拘諸位下印。

translations.literal: On xinsi day an edict ordered each branch secretariat to use only one seal and confiscate the rest, and also confiscated seals held under the various princes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict ordered each branch secretariat to use only one seal and confiscate the rest, and also confiscated seals held by the various princes.

sentences.zh: 發鈔三萬錠，於隆興、德興府、宣德州和糴糧九萬石。

translations.literal: Thirty thousand ingots of notes were issued to purchase harmoniously ninety thousand shi of grain at Longxing, Dexing Prefecture, and Xuande.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty thousand ingots of notes were issued to purchase ninety thousand shi of grain at Longxing, Dexing Prefecture, and Xuande.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜諸王阿只吉金五千兩、銀五萬兩。

translations.literal: On renshen day Prince Azhiji was granted five thousand liang of gold and fifty thousand liang of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Prince Azhiji was granted five thousand liang of gold and fifty thousand liang of silver.

sentences.zh: 厘正選法，置黑簿以籍阿合馬黨人之名；

translations.literal: Selection law was corrected; a black register was established to list the names of Ahmad's faction;
translations.idiomatic: Selection law was corrected; a black register was established to list members of Ahmad's faction;

sentences.zh: 令諸路歲貢儒、吏各一人，各道提刑按察司舉廉能者升等遷敘。

translations.literal: each route was ordered to submit one Confucian scholar and one clerk annually, and each circuit surveillance commission was to recommend the incorruptible and capable for promotion and transfer.
translations.idiomatic: each route was ordered to submit one Confucian scholar and one clerk annually, and each circuit surveillance commission was to recommend the incorruptible and capable for promotion and transfer.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥朔，增兩浙鹽價。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dinghai new moon: Zhejiang salt prices were raised.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the dinghai new moon, Zhejiang salt prices were raised.

sentences.zh: 詔整治鈔法。

translations.literal: An edict ordered paper currency rectified.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered paper currency rectified.

sentences.zh: 己丑，敕河西僧、道、也裏可溫有妻室者，同民納稅。

translations.literal: On jichou day an edict ordered Buddhist monks, Daoists, and Nestorian Christians in Hexi who had wives to pay taxes like commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict ordered Buddhist monks, Daoists, and Nestorian Christians in Hexi who had wives to pay taxes like commoners.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以歲事不登，聽諸軍捕獵於汴梁之南。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, because the harvest failed, all armies were permitted to hunt south of Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, because the harvest failed, all armies were permitted to hunt south of Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以平章軍國重事、監修國史耶律鑄為中書左丞相。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Yelü Zhu, co-administrator of state affairs and overseer of the dynastic history, was made left grand councillor of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Yelü Zhu, co-administrator of state affairs and overseer of the dynastic history, was made left grand councillor of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On renchen day sacrifice was offered at the imperial ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day sacrifice was offered at the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 罷西京宣慰司。

translations.literal: The Xijing pacification commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Xijing pacification commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙申，初立詹事院，以完澤為右詹事，賽陽為左詹事。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the Court of the Heir Apparent was first established; Wanze was made right court administrator and Saiyang left court administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the court of the heir apparent was first established; Wanze was made right court administrator and Saiyang left court administrator.

sentences.zh: 由大都至中灤，中灤至瓜州，設南北兩漕運司。

translations.literal: From Dadu to Central Luan, and from Central Luan to Guazhou, north and south grain transport commissions were established.
translations.idiomatic: From Dadu to Central Luan, and from Central Luan to Guazhou, north and south grain transport commissions were established.

sentences.zh: 立蘆臺越支三叉沽鹽使司，河間滄清、山東濱、樂安及膠萊、莒密鹽使司五。

translations.literal: Five salt transport offices were established: the Lutai Yuezhi Sangcha Salt Transport Office, Hejian Cangqing, Shandong Bin, Lean, and Jiaolai, Ju, and Mi.
translations.idiomatic: Five salt transport offices were established: Lutai Yuezhi Sangcha, Hejian Cangqing, Shandong Bin, Lean, and Jiaolai, Ju, and Mi.

sentences.zh: 敕籍沒財物精好者及金銀幣帛入內帑，余付刑部，以待給賜。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that fine confiscated goods and gold, silver, and silks enter the inner treasury, the rest handed to the Ministry of Justice for later distribution.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered fine confiscated goods and gold, silver, and silks into the inner treasury, with the rest handed to the Ministry of Justice for later distribution.

sentences.zh: 禁中出納分三庫：御用寶玉、遠方珍異隸內藏，金銀、只孫衣段隸右藏，常課衣段、綺羅、縑布隸左藏。

translations.literal: Palace receipts and disbursements were divided among three treasuries: imperial jade and rare objects from distant lands under the inner storehouse, gold and silver and jisun silks under the right storehouse, and regular tribute silks, gauze, and cloth under the left storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: Palace receipts and disbursements were divided among three treasuries: imperial jade and rare objects from distant lands in the inner storehouse, gold and silver and jisun silks in the right storehouse, and regular tribute silks, gauze, and cloth in the left storehouse.

sentences.zh: 設官吏掌鑰者三十二人，仍以宦者二十二人董其事。

translations.literal: Thirty-two officials with keys were established, with twenty-two eunuchs supervising the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-two key-holding officials were appointed, with twenty-two eunuchs supervising them.

sentences.zh: 減大府監官。

translations.literal: Grand Court office officials were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Court office officials were reduced.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命崔彧等鉤考樞密院文卷。

translations.literal: On guimao day Cui Yu and others were ordered to audit Military Affairs Bureau documents.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Cui Yu and others were ordered to audit Military Affairs Bureau documents.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，占城國納款使回，賜以衣服。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the Champa envoys who had submitted returned; clothes were granted them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Champa envoys who had submitted returned; clothes were granted them.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣阿耽招降法裏郎、阿魯、乾伯等國。

translations.literal: On yisi day Ada was dispatched to induce Farlang, Aru, Ganbo, and other countries to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Ada was dispatched to induce Farlang, Aru, Ganbo, and other countries to submit.

sentences.zh: 罷屯田總管府，以其事隸樞密院，令管軍萬戶兼之。

translations.literal: The garrison-farming commissionerate was abolished; its affairs were placed under the Military Affairs Bureau, and military wanhu were ordered to hold the posts concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison-farming commissionerate was abolished; its affairs were placed under the Military Affairs Bureau, and military wanhu were ordered to hold the posts concurrently.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以汪惟孝為總帥。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Wang Weixiao was made commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Wang Weixiao was made commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁未，女直六十自請造船運糧赴鬼國贍軍，從之。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the Jurchen Liushi volunteered to build ships and transport grain to Ghost Country to supply the army; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Jurchen Liushi volunteered to build ships and transport grain to Ghost Country to supply the army; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 議征叉巴洞。

translations.literal: Campaigning against Chaba Cave was discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning against Chaba Cave was discussed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以四川民僅十二萬戶，所設官府二百五十餘，令四川行省議減之。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, because Sichuan had only one hundred twenty thousand households but more than two hundred fifty government offices, the Sichuan Branch Secretariat was ordered to discuss reducing them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, because Sichuan had only 120,000 households but more than 250 government offices, the Sichuan branch secretariat was ordered to discuss reducing them.

sentences.zh: 移成都宣慰司於碉門，罷利州及順慶府宣慰司。

translations.literal: The Chengdu pacification commission was moved to Diaomen, and the Lizhou and Shunqing Prefecture pacification commissions were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengdu pacification commission was moved to Diaomen, and the Lizhou and Shunqing prefecture pacification commissions were abolished.

sentences.zh: 禁大都及山北州郡酒。

translations.literal: Wine was forbidden in Dadu and Shanbei prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Wine was forbidden in Dadu and Shanbei prefectures.

sentences.zh: 詔兩廣、福建五品以下官，從行省就便銓註。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that officials below rank five in Guangdong, Guangxi, and Fujian be appointed conveniently by the branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered officials below rank five in Guangdong, Guangxi, and Fujian appointed at the branch secretariat's discretion.

sentences.zh: 耶律鑄言：「有司官吏以采室女，乘時害民，如令大郡歲取三人，小郡二人，擇其可者，厚賜其父母，否則遣還為宜。

translations.literal: Yelü Zhu said: "Officials gathering palace women seize the occasion to harm the people; if large prefectures take three per year and small prefectures two, choosing those suitable, generously compensating their parents, and otherwise sending them back, that would be appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Zhu said, "Officials gathering palace women seize the occasion to harm the people; if large prefectures take three per year and small prefectures two, choosing those suitable, generously compensating their parents, and otherwise sending them back, that would be appropriate.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

sentences.zh: 籍京畿隱漏田，履畝收稅。

translations.literal: Concealed farmland in the capital region was registered, and tax was collected by measured acreage.
translations.idiomatic: Concealed farmland in the capital region was registered and taxed by measured acreage.

sentences.zh: 命遊顯專領江浙行省漕運。

translations.literal: You Xian was ordered solely in charge of Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: You Xian was placed solely in charge of Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grain transport.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命堅童專掌奏記。

translations.literal: On yimao day Jiantong was ordered solely in charge of memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Jiantong was placed solely in charge of memorials.

sentences.zh: 誅阿合馬長子忽辛、第二子抹速忽於揚州，皆醢之。

translations.literal: Ahmad's eldest son Husin and second son Masuhu were executed at Yangzhou, both pickled.
translations.idiomatic: Ahmad's eldest son Husin and second son Masuhu were executed at Yangzhou and their bodies pickled.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，上都建利用庫。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wu day: a Utilization Treasury was built at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wu day, a utilization treasury was built at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 賜太常禮樂、籍田等二百六十戶鈔千二百錠。

translations.literal: One thousand two hundred ingots were granted to two hundred sixty households of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, ceremonial music, sacred field cultivation, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: 1,200 ingots were granted to 260 households of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, ceremonial music, sacred field cultivation, and the like.

sentences.zh: 甲子，給欠州屯田軍衣服。

translations.literal: On jiazi day clothing was issued to Qianzhou garrison-farming troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day clothing was issued to Qianzhou garrison-farming troops.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，給和林戍還軍校銀鈔、幣帛。

translations.literal: On dingmao day silver notes and silks were issued to officers returning from the Karakorum garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day silver notes and silks were issued to officers returning from the Karakorum garrison.

sentences.zh: 江南襲封衍聖公孔洙入覲，以為國子祭酒，兼提舉浙東道學校事，就給俸祿與護持林廟璽書。

translations.literal: Kong Shu, hereditary Duke of Confucius from Jiangnan, came to audience; he was made chancellor of the National University, concurrently overseeing Zhedong schools, and salary and a seal to maintain the forest temple were granted on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Shu, hereditary Duke of Confucius from Jiangnan, came to audience; he was made chancellor of the National University and concurrently overseer of Zhedong schools, with salary and a seal to maintain the forest temple granted on the spot.

sentences.zh: 詔以阿合馬罪惡頒告中外，凡民間利病即與興除之。

translations.literal: An edict proclaimed Ahmad's crimes at home and abroad; whatever harmed or benefited the people was to be remedied or instituted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict proclaimed Ahmad's crimes at home and abroad; whatever harmed or benefited the people was to be remedied or instituted.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以勢家為商賈者阻遏官民船，立沿河巡禁軍，犯者沒其家。

translations.literal: On renshen day, because powerful families acting as merchants blocked official and private vessels, river patrol troops were established along the waterways; violators' families were forfeited.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, because powerful families acting as merchants blocked official and private vessels, river patrol troops were established along the waterways; violators' families were forfeited.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，分元帥綦公直軍戍曲先。

translations.literal: On guiyou day part of Marshal Qi Gongzhi's army was garrisoned at Quxian.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day part of Marshal Qi Gongzhi's army was garrisoned at Quxian.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，中書省臣言：「天下重囚，除謀反大逆，殺祖父母、父母，妻殺夫，奴殺主，因奸殺夫，並正典刑外，余犯死罪者，令充日本、占城、緬國軍。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Central Secretariat officials said: "Among serious criminals empire-wide, apart from treason, great sedition, killing grandparents or parents, wives killing husbands, slaves killing masters, and killing husbands through adultery—all punished by proper statute—those who committed other capital crimes are to serve as soldiers in Japan, Champa, and Burma.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Central Secretariat officials said, "Among serious criminals empire-wide, apart from treason, great sedition, killing grandparents or parents, wives killing husbands, slaves killing masters, and killing husbands through adultery—all punished by proper statute—those who committed other capital crimes are to serve as soldiers in Japan, Champa, and Burma.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

sentences.zh: 改鑄省印。

translations.literal: Provincial seals were recast.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial seals were recast.

sentences.zh: 丙子，四川行省招諭大盤洞主向臭友等來朝。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the Sichuan Branch Secretariat induced the chiefs of Dapan Cave, including Xiang Chouyou, to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Sichuan branch secretariat induced the chiefs of Dapan Cave, including Xiang Chouyou, to come to court.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，耶律鑄言：「前奉詔殺人者死，仍征燒埋銀伍十兩，後止征鈔二錠，其事太輕。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Yelü Zhu said: "Earlier an edict ordered that murderers be put to death and still pay fifty liang of burning-burial silver; later only two ingots of notes were collected—the penalty is too light.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Yelü Zhu said, "Earlier an edict ordered murderers put to death and still pay fifty liang of burning-burial silver; later only two ingots of notes were collected—the penalty is too light.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，依蒙古人例，犯者沒一女入仇家，無女者征鈔四錠。

translations.literal: We propose that, following Mongol custom, the offender forfeit a daughter to the victim's family, and if there is no daughter, four ingots of notes be collected.
translations.idiomatic: We propose that, following Mongol custom, the offender forfeit a daughter to the victim's family, and if there is no daughter, four ingots of notes be collected.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

sentences.zh: 以袁州、饒州、興國軍復隸隆興省。

translations.literal: Yuan Prefecture, Rao Prefecture, and Xingguo Army were again placed under Longxing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Prefecture, Rao Prefecture, and Xingguo Army were again placed under Longxing Province.

sentences.zh: 馬八兒國遣使以金葉書及土物來貢。

translations.literal: Ma'bar dispatched envoys with a gold-leaf letter and local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ma'bar sent envoys with a gold-leaf letter and local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 罷都功德使脫烈，其修設佛事妄費官物，皆征還之。

translations.literal: Chief Merit Commissioner Tuolie was dismissed; Buddhist rites he had arranged at government expense were all recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Chief merit commissioner Tuolie was dismissed; Buddhist rites he had arranged at government expense were all recovered.

sentences.zh: 賜貧乏者合納塔兒、八隻等羊馬鈔。

translations.literal: Notes for sheep and horses were granted to the poor among Henanar, Bazi, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Notes for sheep and horses were granted to the poor among Henanar, Bazi, and others.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，命阿剌海領範文虎等所有海船三百艘。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dinghai day: Alahai was ordered to take charge of three hundred sea ships belonging to Fan Wenhu and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dinghai day, Alahai was ordered to take charge of three hundred sea ships belonging to Fan Wenhu and others.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，中書左丞張文謙為樞密副使。

translations.literal: On renyin day Zhang Wenqian, left associate of the Central Secretariat, was made deputy commissioner of the Military Affairs Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Zhang Wenqian, left associate of the Central Secretariat, was made deputy commissioner of the Military Affairs Bureau.

sentences.zh: 乙未，中書省臣言：「平原郡公趙與芮、瀛國公趙鳷、翰林直學士趙與票，宜並居上都。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Central Secretariat officials said: "Duke of Pingyuan Zhao Yourui, Duke of Ying Zhao Qi, and Hanlin direct academician Zhao Yubiao should all reside at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Central Secretariat officials said, "Duke of Pingyuan Zhao Yourui, Duke of Ying Zhao Qi, and Hanlin direct academician Zhao Yubiao should all reside at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「與芮老矣，當留大都，余如所言。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Yourui is old; he should remain in Dadu; the rest as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Yourui is old; he should remain in Dadu; the rest as proposed.

sentences.zh: 」繼有旨，給瀛國公衣糧發遣之，唯與票勿行。

translations.literal: " An edict then ordered supplies given and Zhao Qi sent off; only Zhao Yubiao was not to go.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict then ordered supplies given and Zhao Qi sent off; only Zhao Yubiao was not to go.

sentences.zh: 以中山薛保住上匿名書告變，殺宋丞相文天祥。

translations.literal: Because Zhongshan Xue Baozhu submitted an anonymous letter denouncing treason, Song chancellor Wen Tianxiang was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Because Zhongshan Xue Baozhu submitted an anonymous letter denouncing treason, Song chancellor Wen Tianxiang was executed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，御史中丞崔彧言：「臺臣於國家政事得失、生民休戚、百官邪正，雖王公將相亦宜糾察。

translations.literal: On guimao day censor-in-chief Cui Yu said: "Censorial officials, regarding the gains and losses of state affairs, the welfare and hardship of the people, and the upright and corrupt among officials—even princes, dukes, generals, and ministers—should all impeach and investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day censor-in-chief Cui Yu said, "Censorial officials, regarding the gains and losses of state affairs, the welfare and hardship of the people, and the upright and corrupt among officials—even princes, dukes, generals, and ministers—should all impeach and investigate.

sentences.zh: 近唯御史有言，臣以為臺官皆當建言，庶於國家有補。

translations.literal: Recently only censors have spoken; I hold that all censorial officials should offer advice, so that the state may benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Recently only censors have spoken; I hold that all censorial officials should offer advice, so that the state may benefit.

sentences.zh: 選用臺察官，若由中書，必有偏徇之弊。

translations.literal: In selecting censorial officials, if done by the Central Secretariat there will surely be partiality.
translations.idiomatic: In selecting censorial officials, if done by the Central Secretariat there will surely be partiality.

sentences.zh: 御史宜從本臺選擇，初用漢人十六員，今用蒙古人十六員，相參巡歷為宜。

translations.literal: Censors should be chosen from this bureau itself; initially sixteen Han officials were used, but now sixteen Mongols are used—mixing them in circuit tours would be appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Censors should be chosen from the censorate itself; initially sixteen Han officials were used, but now sixteen Mongols are used—mixing them on circuit tours would be appropriate.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

sentences.zh: 浚濟川河。

translations.literal: The Jichuan River was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The Jichuan River was dredged.

sentences.zh: 降拱衛司復正四品，仍收其虎符。

translations.literal: The Guard of the Heir Apparent was reduced back to rank four, and its tiger tally was again collected.
translations.idiomatic: The guard of the heir apparent was reduced back to rank four, and its tiger tally was again collected.

sentences.zh: 罷湖廣行省金銀鐵冶提舉司，以其事隸各路總管府。

translations.literal: The Hubei-Guangdong Branch Secretariat gold, silver, and iron smelting bureau was abolished; its affairs were placed under the various route chief offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Hubei-Guangdong branch secretariat gold, silver, and iron smelting bureau was abolished; its affairs were placed under the various route chief offices.

sentences.zh: 以建康淘金總管府隸建康路。

translations.literal: The Jiankang gold-washing commissionerate was placed under Jiankang Route.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiankang gold-washing commissionerate was placed under Jiankang Route.

sentences.zh: 中書右丞劄散為平章政事。

translations.literal: Right associate of the Central Secretariat Zhachan was made co-administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Right associate of the Central Secretariat Zhachan was made co-administrator.

sentences.zh: 罷解鹽司及諸鹽司，令運司官親行調度鹽引。

translations.literal: The Jie salt office and the various salt offices were abolished; transport officials were ordered to dispatch salt certificates in person.
translations.idiomatic: The Jie salt office and the various salt offices were abolished; transport officials were ordered to dispatch salt certificates in person.

sentences.zh: 罷南京屯田總管府，以其事隸南陽府。

translations.literal: The Nanjing garrison-farming commissionerate was abolished; its affairs were placed under Nanyang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanjing garrison-farming commissionerate was abolished; its affairs were placed under Nanyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 阿裏海牙復鎮遠軍，發軍千人戍守，以其地與西川行省接，就以隸焉。

translations.literal: Ali Haiya restored the Zhenyuan Army; one thousand troops were dispatched to garrison it, and because the place adjoined the West Sichuan Branch Secretariat it was placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: Ali Haiya restored the Zhenyuan Army; one thousand troops were dispatched to garrison it, and because the place adjoined the West Sichuan branch secretariat it was placed under it.

sentences.zh: 詔立帝師答耳麻八剌剌吉塔，掌玉印，統領諸國釋教。

translations.literal: An edict established Imperial Preceptor Dharmapala Raktajita, holding the jade seal and overseeing Buddhist clergy of all countries.
translations.idiomatic: An edict established Imperial Preceptor Dharmapala Raktajita, holding the jade seal and overseeing Buddhist clergy of all countries.

sentences.zh: 造帝師八合思八舍利塔。

translations.literal: A stupa for Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa was built.
translations.idiomatic: A stupa for Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa was built.

sentences.zh: 免鞏昌等處積年所欠田租稅課。

translations.literal: Accumulated land rent, tax, and levies owed in Gongchang and other places were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated land rent, tax, and levies owed in Gongchang and other places were remitted.

sentences.zh: 賜皇子北安王位下塔察兒等馬牛羊各有差。

translations.literal: Horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in graded amounts to Tachar and others under Prince North An.
translations.idiomatic: Horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in graded amounts to Tachar and others under Prince North An.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月丙辰朔，高麗國王王春遣其大將軍俞洪慎來賀。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, spring, first month, on the bingchen new moon, King Wang Chun of Goryeo dispatched his grand general Yu Hongshen to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, on the bingchen new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent his grand general Yu Hongshen to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 己未，納皇后弘吉剌氏。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the empress of the Hongjira clan was installed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the empress of the Hongjira clan was installed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜諸王出伯印，賞諸王必赤帖木兒、駙馬昌吉軍鈔。

translations.literal: On xinyou day a seal was granted to Prince Chubo, and army notes were granted as rewards to Prince Bichitemür and consort Changji.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day a seal was granted to Prince Chubo, and army notes were granted as rewards to Prince Bichitemür and consort Changji.

sentences.zh: 敕諸王、公主、駙馬得江南分地者，於一萬戶田租中輸鈔百錠，準中原五戶絲數。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law who held Jiangnan appanages pay one hundred ingots from the rent of ten thousand households, equivalent to the Central Plains five-households silk quota.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law who held Jiangnan appanages to pay one hundred ingots from the rent of ten thousand households, equivalent to the Central Plains five-households silk quota.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，敕藥剌海領軍征緬國。

translations.literal: On guihai day Yao Lahai was ordered to lead an army against Burma.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Yao Lahai was ordered to lead an army against Burma.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，高麗國王王春遣使兀剌帶貢氎布線綢等物四百段。

translations.literal: On yichou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo dispatched the envoy Wuladai to present four hundred bolts of felt cloth, thread silk, and the like as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent the envoy Wuladai to present four hundred bolts of felt cloth, thread silk, and the like as tribute.

sentences.zh: 和禮霍孫言：「去冬中山府奸民薛寶住為匿名書來上，妄效東方朔書，欺罔朝廷，希覬官賞。

translations.literal: Helü Huosun said: "Last winter the villain Xue Baozhu of Zhongshan Prefecture submitted an anonymous letter, foolishly imitating Dongfang Shuo's style, deceiving the court and hoping for an official reward.
translations.idiomatic: Helü Huosun said, "Last winter the villain Xue Baozhu of Zhongshan Prefecture submitted an anonymous letter, foolishly imitating Dongfang Shuo's style, deceiving the court and hoping for an official reward.

sentences.zh: 」敕誅之。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered him executed.

translations.literal: On bingyin day the imperial carriage went to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the imperial carriage went to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 江西行省參政完顏那懷，坐越例驟升及妄舉一百九十八人入官，罷之。

translations.literal: Jiangxi branch secretariat administrator Wanyan Nahua'i was dismissed for exceeding precedent in sudden promotion and improperly recommending one hundred ninety-eight persons for office.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi branch secretariat administrator Wanyan Nahua'i was dismissed for exceeding precedent in sudden promotion and improperly recommending 198 persons for office.

sentences.zh: 罷河西辦課提舉司。

translations.literal: The Hexi revenue-collection supervisory office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Hexi revenue-collection supervisory office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，增置蒙古監察御史六員。

translations.literal: On dingmao day six Mongol supervising censors were added.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day six Mongol supervising censors were added.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，歲星犯房。

translations.literal: On yisi day Jupiter transgressed Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Jupiter transgressed Fang.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，歲星掩房。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Jupiter occulted Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Jupiter occulted Fang.

sentences.zh: 廣州新會縣林桂方、趙良鈐等聚眾，偽號羅平國，稱延康年號，官軍擒之，伏誅，余黨悉平。

translations.literal: Lin Guifang, Zhao Liangqian, and others of Xinhui county, Guangzhou, gathered a crowd, falsely styled themselves the Luoping State, and proclaimed the Yankang reign title; government troops captured them, they were executed, and the remaining followers were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Guifang, Zhao Liangqian, and others of Xinhui county, Guangzhou, gathered a crowd, falsely styled themselves the Luoping State, and proclaimed the Yankang reign title; government troops captured them, they were executed, and the remaining followers were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，罷諸處役夫。

translations.literal: On yihai day corvée laborers everywhere were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day corvée laborers everywhere were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 遣阿塔海戍曲先，漢都魯迷失帥甘州新附軍往斡端。

translations.literal: Atahai was dispatched to garrison Quxian; Handulu Shimi led newly submitted Ganzhou troops to Wandan.
translations.idiomatic: Atahai was dispatched to garrison Quxian; Handulu Shimi led newly submitted Ganzhou troops to Wandan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，給各衛軍出征馬價鈔。

translations.literal: On jimao day paper currency for horse prices was issued to guard troops on expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day paper currency for horse prices was issued to guard troops on expedition.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，立畏吾兒四處驛及交鈔庫。

translations.literal: On xinsi day four Uighur relay stations and note exchange treasuries were established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day four Uighur relay stations and note exchange treasuries were established.

sentences.zh: 壬午，祀太一。

translations.literal: On renwu day Taiyi was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Taiyi was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 罷福建道宣慰司，復立行中書省於漳州，以中書右丞張惠為平章政事，御史中丞也先帖木兒為中書左丞，並行中書省事。

translations.literal: The Fujian circuit pacification commission was abolished; a branch secretariat was re-established at Zhangzhou; Central Secretariat right vice chancellor Zhang Hui was made grand councillor, censor-in-chief Esentemur left vice chancellor; both directed branch secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian circuit pacification commission was abolished; a branch secretariat was re-established at Zhangzhou; Central Secretariat right vice chancellor Zhang Hui was made grand councillor and censor-in-chief Esentemur left vice chancellor; both directed branch secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 賜迷裏劄蠻、合八失鈔。

translations.literal: Notes were granted to Mili Zaman and Hebasi.
translations.idiomatic: Notes were granted to Mili Zaman and Hebasi.

sentences.zh: 賑八魯怯薛、八剌合赤等貧乏。

translations.literal: Relief was given to the impoverished of the Balu keshik, Balakachi, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Relief was given to the impoverished of the Balu keshik, Balakachi, and others.

sentences.zh: 賜皇子北平王所部馬牛羊各有差。

translations.literal: Horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in varying amounts to troops under Prince Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in varying amounts to troops under Prince Beiping.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，立別十八里、和州等處宣慰司。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingxu day: a pacification commission was established at Bie Shibali, Hezhou, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, bingxu day: a pacification commission was established at Bie Shibali, Hezhou, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，敕藥剌海戍守亦奚不薛。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Yalihai was ordered to garrison and guard Yixibuxi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Yalihai was ordered to garrison and guard Yixibuxi.

sentences.zh: 都元帥也速答兒還自亦奚不薛，駐軍成都，求入見，許之，仍遣人屯守險隘。

translations.literal: Grand marshal Yesu'er returned from Yixibuxi, encamped at Chengdu, requested an audience, and was granted it; men were still dispatched to garrison strategic passes.
translations.idiomatic: Grand marshal Yesu'er returned from Yixibuxi, encamped at Chengdu, requested an audience, and was granted it; men were still dispatched to garrison strategic passes.

sentences.zh: 以侍衛親軍二萬人助征日本。

translations.literal: Twenty thousand imperial guard troops were assigned to assist the Japan expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty thousand imperial guard troops were assigned to assist the Japan expedition.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，樞密院臣言：「蒙古侍衛軍於新城等處屯田，砂礫不可種，乞改撥良田。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Privy Council officials said: "Mongol imperial guard troops farming at Xincheng and elsewhere find gravel unsuitable for planting; we request reassignment to good fields."
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Privy Council officials said, "Mongol imperial guard troops farming at Xincheng and elsewhere find gravel unsuitable for planting; we request reassignment to good fields."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，阿塔海求軍官習舟楫者同征日本，命元帥張林、招討張瑄、總管朱清等行。

translations.literal: On renchen day Atahai requested naval-trained army officers for the Japan expedition; marshals Zhang Lin, pacification commissioner Zhang Xuan, and supervisor Zhu Qing and others were ordered to go.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Atahai requested naval-trained army officers for the Japan expedition; marshals Zhang Lin, pacification commissioner Zhang Xuan, and supervisor Zhu Qing and others were ordered to go.

sentences.zh: 以高麗王就領行省，規畫日本事宜。

translations.literal: The king of Goryeo was put in charge of the branch secretariat to plan Japan affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Goryeo was put in charge of the branch secretariat to plan Japan affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲午，減江南諸道醫學提舉司，四省各存其一。

translations.literal: On jiawu day medical supervisory offices in Jiangnan circuits were reduced; one was kept in each of the four provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day medical supervisory offices in Jiangnan circuits were reduced; one was kept in each of the four provinces.

sentences.zh: 免京畿所括豪勢田舊稅三之二、新稅三之一。

translations.literal: Two-thirds of old tax and one-third of new tax on powerful-estate lands registered in the capital region were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Two-thirds of old tax and one-third of new tax on powerful-estate lands registered in the capital region were remitted.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王春請以蒙古人同行省事。

translations.literal: King Wang Chun of Goryeo requested that Mongols serve jointly in branch secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo requested that Mongols serve jointly in branch secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 禁近侍為人求官，紊亂選法。

translations.literal: Court attendants were forbidden to seek offices for others and disrupt the selection system.
translations.idiomatic: Court attendants were forbidden to seek offices for others and disrupt the selection system.

sentences.zh: 申嚴酒禁，有私造者，財產、女子沒官，犯人配役。

translations.literal: The alcohol prohibition was strictly enforced: private distillers' property and female dependents were confiscated by the state and offenders were assigned to corvée.
translations.idiomatic: The alcohol prohibition was strictly enforced: private distillers' property and female dependents were confiscated by the state and offenders were assigned to corvée.

sentences.zh: 申私鹽之禁，許按察司糾察鹽司。

translations.literal: The private salt prohibition was enforced; surveillance commissions were permitted to investigate salt offices.
translations.idiomatic: The private salt prohibition was enforced; surveillance commissions were permitted to investigate salt offices.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太陰犯房。

translations.literal: On jihai day the moon transgressed Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the moon transgressed Fang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: On renyin day the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，授高麗國王王春征東行中書省左丞相，仍駙馬、高麗國王。

translations.literal: On guimao day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was appointed left grand councillor of the Japan Expedition Branch Secretariat, retaining the titles of imperial son-in-law and King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was appointed left grand councillor of the Japan expedition branch secretariat, retaining the titles of imperial son-in-law and King of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命樞密院集軍官議征日本事宜，程鵬飛請明賞罰，有功者軍前給憑驗，候班師日改授，從之。

translations.literal: On yisi day the Privy Council was ordered to assemble military officers to deliberate on the Japan expedition; Cheng Pengfei asked that rewards and punishments be made clear, that the meritorious receive verification credentials at the front and be formally appointed upon return, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the Privy Council was ordered to assemble military officers to deliberate on the Japan expedition; Cheng Pengfei asked that rewards and punishments be made clear, that the meritorious receive verification credentials at the front and be formally appointed upon return, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，右丞也速帶兒招撫筠連州、定州、阿永、都掌等處蠻，獨山都掌蠻不降，進軍討之，生擒酋長得蘭紐，遂班師。

translations.literal: On gengxu day right vice chancellor Yesudai'er pacified the peoples of Junlian, Ding, Ayong, Duzhang, and other places; the Dushan Duzhang people would not submit, so he advanced to attack them, captured alive their chief Delanniu, and then withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day right vice chancellor Yesudai'er pacified the peoples of Junlian, Ding, Ayong, Duzhang, and other places; the Dushan Duzhang people would not submit, so he advanced against them, captured their chief Delanniu alive, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 發大都所造回回炮及其匠張林等，付征東行省。

translations.literal: Muslim catapults made at Dadu and their artisans Zhang Lin and others were dispatched to the Japan Expedition Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Muslim catapults made at Dadu and their artisans Zhang Lin and others were sent to the Japan expedition branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以征日本，給後衛軍衣甲，及大名、衛輝新附軍鈔。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, for the campaign against Japan, clothing and armor were granted to the Rear Guard Army, and paper currency to the newly submitted armies of Daming and Weihui.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, for the campaign against Japan, clothing and armor were granted to the Rear Guard Army and paper currency to the newly submitted armies of Daming and Weihui.

sentences.zh: 麥術丁等檢核萬億庫，以罪監系者多，請付蒙古人治。

translations.literal: Maishuding and others audited the Treasury of Myriad Myriads; because many persons imprisoned on charges were involved, they asked that the case be transferred to Mongol officials.
translations.idiomatic: Maishuding and others audited the Treasury of Myriad Myriads; because many persons imprisoned on charges were involved, they asked that the case be transferred to Mongol officials.

sentences.zh: 有旨：「蒙古人為利所汩，亦異往日矣，其擇可任者使之。」

translations.literal: An imperial instruction said: "Mongols tainted by profit are no longer as in former days; let those fit for appointment be selected and entrusted."
translations.idiomatic: An imperial instruction said, "Mongols tainted by profit are no longer as in former days; let those fit for appointment be selected and entrusted."

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，給甘州戍軍夏衣。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on yimao day, summer clothing was issued to the garrison troops of Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yimao day, summer clothing was issued to the garrison troops of Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，丞相伯顏、諸王相吾答兒等言：「征緬國軍宜參用蒙古、新附軍。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Chancellor Bayan, Prince Xiangwada'er, and others said: "The army campaigning against Burma should employ both Mongol and newly submitted troops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Chancellor Bayan, Prince Xiangwada'er, and others said, "The army campaigning against Burma should employ both Mongol and newly submitted troops.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 己未，免五衛軍征日本，發萬人赴上都。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the five guard armies were exempted from the Japan expedition, and ten thousand men were sent to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the five guard armies were exempted from the Japan expedition and 10,000 men were sent to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 縱平灤造船軍歸耕，撥大都見管軍代役。

translations.literal: Shipbuilding troops of Pingluan were released to return to farming, and troops under Dadu's direct command were assigned to take their place.
translations.idiomatic: Pingluan shipbuilding troops were released to return to farming, and troops under Dadu's direct command were assigned to take their place.

sentences.zh: 庚申，減隆興府昌州蓋裏泊管鹽官吏九十九人，以其事隸隆興府。

translations.literal: On gengshen day ninety-nine salt-administration officials of Gaili Saltworks in Chang Prefecture of Longxing were reduced, and the affair was placed under Longxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day ninety-nine salt-administration officials of Gaili Saltworks in Chang Prefecture of Longxing were cut, and the affair was placed under Longxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 定江南民官及轉運司官公田。

translations.literal: Official fields for Jiangnan civil officials and transport commissioners were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Official fields for Jiangnan civil officials and transport commissioners were fixed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，徙揚州淘金夫赴益都。

translations.literal: On jiazi day gold-washing laborers of Yangzhou were transferred to Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day gold-washing laborers of Yangzhou were transferred to Yidu.

sentences.zh: 立征東行中書省，以高麗國王與阿塔海共事，給高麗國征日本軍衣甲。

translations.literal: The Japan Expedition Branch Secretariat was established; the King of Goryeo and Atahai were to serve together, and clothing and armor for Goryeo's Japan expedition army were granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Japan expedition branch secretariat was established; the King of Goryeo and Atahai were to serve together, and clothing and armor for Goryeo's Japan expedition army were granted.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞崔彧言：「江南盜賊相繼而起，皆緣拘水手、造海船，民不聊生，日本之役，宜姑止之。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Cui Yu said: "Bandits in Jiangnan have risen one after another, all because sailors are conscripted and sea ships are built, until the people cannot survive; the Japan expedition should for the time being be halted.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Cui Yu said, "Bandits in Jiangnan have risen one after another, all because sailors are conscripted and sea ships are built until the people cannot survive; the Japan expedition should for the time being be halted.

sentences.zh: 江南四省應辦軍需，宜量民力，勿強以土產所無，凡給物價及民者必以實。

translations.literal: The four Jiangnan provinces supplying military needs should measure the people's strength, not force them to supply what their lands do not produce, and whenever prices or goods are taken from the people they must be paid in full.
translations.idiomatic: The four Jiangnan provinces supplying military needs should measure the people's strength, not force them to supply what their lands do not produce, and whenever prices or goods are taken from the people they must be paid in full.

sentences.zh: 召募水手，當從所欲。

translations.literal: When recruiting sailors, their wishes should be followed.
translations.idiomatic: When recruiting sailors, their wishes should be followed.

sentences.zh: 伺民之氣稍蘇，我之力粗備，三二年復東征未晚。

translations.literal: When the people's spirits have somewhat revived and our strength is roughly prepared, another eastern expedition in two or three years would not be late.
translations.idiomatic: When the people's spirits have somewhat revived and our strength is roughly prepared, another eastern expedition in two or three years would not be late.

sentences.zh: 」不從。

translations.literal: " The request was denied.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太陰掩心東星。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the moon eclipsed the eastern star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the moon eclipsed the eastern star of Heart.

sentences.zh: 免江南稅糧三之二。

translations.literal: Two-thirds of Jiangnan grain tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Two-thirds of Jiangnan grain tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 敕阿裏海牙調漢軍七千、新附軍八千，以付唆都從征。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Ala Haiya to deploy seven thousand Han troops and eight thousand newly submitted troops and assign them to Suodu for the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Ala Haiya to deploy 7,000 Han troops and 8,000 newly submitted troops and assign them to Suodu for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 辛未，占城行省已破占城，其國主補底遁去，降璽書招徠之。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the Champa branch secretariat had already broken Champa; its king Budi fled, and an imperial letter was issued to summon him to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Champa branch secretariat had already broken Champa; its king Budi fled, and an imperial letter was issued to summon him to submit.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，發征日本重囚往占城、緬國等處從征。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day heavy criminals from the Japan expedition were sent to Champa, Burma, and other places to join the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day heavy criminals from the Japan expedition were sent to Champa, Burma, and other places to join the campaign.

sentences.zh: 設高麗國勸農官四員。

translations.literal: Four agriculture-promotion officials were established for Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Four agriculture-promotion officials were established for Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔諭諸王相吾答兒：「先是雲南重囚令便宜處決，恐濫及無辜，自今凡大辟罪，仍須待報。

translations.literal: On bingzi day an edict instructed Prince Xiangwada'er: "Formerly serious criminals in Yunnan were allowed summary execution at convenience, for fear of implicating the innocent; from now on all capital crimes must still await imperial confirmation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict instructed Prince Xiangwada'er, "Formerly serious criminals in Yunnan were allowed summary execution at convenience for fear of implicating the innocent; from now on all capital crimes must still await imperial confirmation.

sentences.zh: 」並省江淮、雲南州郡。

translations.literal: " The prefectures and districts of Jianghuai and Yunnan were also consolidated.
translations.idiomatic: " The prefectures and districts of Jianghuai and Yunnan were also consolidated.

sentences.zh: 以耶律老哥為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: Yelü Laoge was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Laoge was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 免戍軍差稅。

translations.literal: Corvée tax on garrison troops was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée tax on garrison troops was remitted.

sentences.zh: 禁諸王奧魯官科擾軍戶。

translations.literal: Princes' ordu officials were forbidden to levy exactions on military households.
translations.idiomatic: Princes' ordu officials were forbidden to levy exactions on military households.

sentences.zh: 以西南蠻夷有謀叛未附者，免西川征緬軍，令專守禦，支錢令各驛供給。

translations.literal: Because southwestern barbarians were plotting rebellion and had not yet submitted, the Sichuan army campaigning against Burma was exempted and ordered to guard exclusively; funds were disbursed for each relay station to supply them.
translations.idiomatic: Because southwestern barbarians were plotting rebellion and had not yet submitted, the Sichuan army campaigning against Burma was exempted and ordered to guard exclusively, and funds were disbursed for each relay station to supply them.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，諸陳言者從都省集議，可行者以聞，不可則明以諭言者。

translations.literal: On wuyin day all memorialists were gathered for deliberation at the metropolitan secretariat; what was feasible was reported upward, and what was not was clearly explained to the memorialists.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day all memorialists were gathered for deliberation at the metropolitan secretariat; what was feasible was reported upward, and what was not was clearly explained to the memorialists.

sentences.zh: 許按察司官用弓矢。

translations.literal: Surveillance commissioners were permitted to use bows and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance commissioners were permitted to use bows and arrows.

sentences.zh: 監察御史阿剌渾坐擅免贓錢、不糾私釀等罪罷。

translations.literal: Supervising censor Alahun was dismissed on charges of arbitrarily remitting fine money and failing to investigate private brewing.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censor Alahun was dismissed on charges of arbitrarily remitting fine money and failing to investigate private brewing.

sentences.zh: 用御史中丞崔彧言，罷各路選取室女。

translations.literal: Following Censor-in-chief Cui Yu's memorial, the selection of maidens in all routes was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Following censor-in-chief Cui Yu's memorial, the selection of maidens in all routes was abolished.

sentences.zh: 頒行宋文思院小口斛。

translations.literal: The small-capacity hu of the Song Wensi Court was promulgated for use.
translations.idiomatic: The small-capacity hu of the Song Wensi Court was promulgated for use.

sentences.zh: 敕以陜西按察司贓罰錢輸於秦王。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that fine money from the Shaanxi surveillance commission be delivered to the Prince of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that fine money from the Shaanxi surveillance commission be delivered to the Prince of Qin.

sentences.zh: 省北京提刑按察司副使、僉事各一員。

translations.literal: One associate deputy commissioner and one registrar of the Beijing Circuit surveillance commission were cut.
translations.idiomatic: One associate deputy commissioner and one registrar of the Beijing circuit surveillance commission were cut.

sentences.zh: 立海西遼東提刑按察司，按治女直、水達達部。

translations.literal: The Maritime and Eastern Liaodong Circuit Surveillance Commission was established to investigate the Jurchen and Sushen tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The Maritime and Eastern Liaodong circuit surveillance commission was established to investigate the Jurchen and Sushen tribes.

sentences.zh: 己卯，酬諸王只必帖木兒給軍羊馬鈔十萬錠。

translations.literal: On jimao day Prince Zhibietemu'er was compensated with one hundred thousand ingots of paper currency for sheep and horses supplied to the army.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Prince Zhibietemu'er was compensated with 100,000 ingots of paper currency for sheep and horses supplied to the army.

sentences.zh: 海南四州宣慰使朱國寶請益兵討占城國主，詔以阿裏海牙軍萬五千人應之。

translations.literal: Hainan Four Prefectures pacification commissioner Zhu Guobao asked for additional troops to campaign against the King of Champa; an edict granted him fifteen thousand men from Ala Haiya's army.
translations.idiomatic: Hainan Four Prefectures pacification commissioner Zhu Guobao asked for additional troops to campaign against the King of Champa; an edict granted him 15,000 men from Ala Haiya's army.

sentences.zh: 用王積翁言，詔江南運糧，於阿八赤新開神山河及海道兩道運之。

translations.literal: Following Wang Jiweng's memorial, an edict directed that Jiangnan grain be transported by the two routes of Abaqchi's newly opened Shenshan River and by sea.
translations.idiomatic: Following Wang Jiweng's memorial, an edict directed that Jiangnan grain be transported by the two routes of Abaqchi's newly opened Shenshan River and by sea.

sentences.zh: 立斡脫總管府。

translations.literal: The Otrot Headquarters was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Otrot headquarters was established.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，給占城行省唆都弓矢甲仗。

translations.literal: On xinsi day bows, arrows, and armor were granted to Suodu of the Champa branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day bows, arrows, and armor were granted to Suodu of the Champa branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，申嚴私易金銀之禁。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingxu day, the prohibition on private exchange of gold and silver was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingxu day, the prohibition on private exchange of gold and silver was strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 以甘州行省參政王椅為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: Ganzhou Branch Secretariat associate administrator Wang Yi was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Ganzhou branch secretariat associate administrator Wang Yi was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 免大都及平灤路今歲絲料。

translations.literal: This year's silk tax of Dadu and Pingluan routes was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: This year's silk tax of Dadu and Pingluan routes was remitted.

sentences.zh: 江南遷轉官不之任者杖之，追奪所受宣敕。

translations.literal: Transferred Jiangnan officials who failed to take up their posts were caned and their received patents and commissions were revoked.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred Jiangnan officials who failed to take up their posts were caned and their received patents and commissions were revoked.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以征日本，民間騷動，盜賊竊發，忽都帖木兒、忙古帶乞益兵禦寇，詔以興國、江州軍付之。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, because of the Japan expedition, the populace was disturbed and bandits broke out in theft; Hudutemur and Mangudai asked for additional troops to suppress bandits, and an edict assigned them the armies of Xingguo and Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, because of the Japan expedition, the populace was disturbed and bandits broke out; Hudutemur and Mangudai asked for additional troops to suppress them, and an edict assigned them the armies of Xingguo and Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，增官吏俸給。

translations.literal: On jichou day officials' salary allotments were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day officials' salary allotments were increased.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，定市舶抽分例，舶貨精者取十之一，粗者十五之一。

translations.literal: On gengyin day maritime trade assessment rates were fixed: one-tenth on fine imported goods and one-fifteenth on coarse goods.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day maritime trade assessment rates were fixed: one-tenth on fine imported goods and one-fifteenth on coarse goods.

sentences.zh: 差五衛軍人修築行殿外垣。

translations.literal: Five guard army troops were assigned to repair the outer wall of the travelling palace.
translations.idiomatic: Five guard army troops were assigned to repair the outer wall of the travelling palace.

sentences.zh: 命諸王忽牙都設斷事官。

translations.literal: Prince Huyadu was ordered to establish judges of cases.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Huyadu was ordered to establish judges of cases.

sentences.zh: 丙申，發軍修完大都城。

translations.literal: On bingshen day troops were dispatched to repair and complete Dadu city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day troops were dispatched to repair and complete Dadu city.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，發軍修築堤堰。

translations.literal: On xinchou day troops were dispatched to build and repair dikes and weirs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day troops were dispatched to build and repair dikes and weirs.

sentences.zh: 戊申，用伯顏等言，所括宋手號軍八萬三千六百人，立牌甲設官以統之，仍給衣糧。

translations.literal: On wushen day, following Bayan and others' memorial, the eighty-three thousand six hundred Song troops conscripted by hand-tally were organized under commanders and officials with registers and armor, and clothing and grain were still granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, following Bayan and others' memorial, the 83,600 Song troops conscripted by hand-tally were organized under commanders and officials with registers and armor, and clothing and grain were still granted.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，流叛賊陳吊眼叔陳桂龍於憨答孫之地。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Chen Diaoyan's uncle, the rebel Chen Guilong, was exiled to Handasun's territory.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Chen Diaoyan's uncle, the rebel Chen Guilong, was exiled to Handasun's territory.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，四川行省參政曲立吉思等討平九溪十八洞，以其酋長赴闕，定其地，立州縣，聽順元路宣慰司節制。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Sichuan Branch Secretariat associate administrator Qurugjin and others pacified the Nine Streams and Eighteen Caves, brought their chiefs to court, fixed their territories, established prefectures and counties, and placed them under the command of Shunyuan Route pacification commission.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Sichuan branch secretariat associate administrator Qurugjin and others pacified the Nine Streams and Eighteen Caves, brought their chiefs to court, fixed their territories, established prefectures and counties, and placed them under Shunyuan Route pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 以向世雄等為叉巴諸洞安撫大使及安撫使。

translations.literal: Xiang Shixiong and others were made grand pacification ambassadors and pacification commissioners of the Cha-ba caves.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Shixiong and others were made grand pacification ambassadors and pacification commissioners of the Cha-ba caves.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑朔，蠲建寧路至元十七年前未納苗稅。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, guichou new moon: unpaid seedling tax of Jianning Route before the seventeenth year was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the guichou new moon, unpaid seedling tax of Jianning Route before the seventeenth year was remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，免征骨嵬軍賦。

translations.literal: On bingchen day military levies of the Guwei tribe were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day military levies of the Guwei tribe were remitted.

sentences.zh: 諭阿塔海所造征日本船，宜少緩之；

translations.literal: It was instructed that Atahai's Japan expedition ships should be built somewhat more slowly;
translations.idiomatic: It was instructed that Atahai's Japan expedition ships should be built somewhat more slowly;

sentences.zh: 所拘商船，其悉給還。

translations.literal: all detained merchant vessels should be fully returned.
translations.idiomatic: and all detained merchant vessels should be fully returned.

sentences.zh: 阿裏沙坐虛言惑眾誅。

translations.literal: Alisha was executed for using false words to mislead the crowd.
translations.idiomatic: Alisha was executed for using false words to mislead the crowd.

sentences.zh: 太白犯井。

translations.literal: Venus transgressed Well.
translations.idiomatic: Venus transgressed Well.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賜捏古帶等珠衣。

translations.literal: On dingsi day pearl garments were granted to Niegudai and others.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day pearl garments were granted to Niegudai and others.

sentences.zh: 庚申，調軍益戍雲南。

translations.literal: On gengshen day troops were transferred to reinforce the Yunnan garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day troops were transferred to reinforce the Yunnan garrison.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，立亦奚不薛宣慰司，益兵戍守。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the Yixibuxue Pacification Commission was established and additional troops were garrisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Yixibuxue pacification commission was established and additional troops were garrisoned.

sentences.zh: 開雲南驛路。

translations.literal: Yunnan relay routes were opened.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan relay routes were opened.

sentences.zh: 分亦奚不薛地為三，設官撫治之。

translations.literal: Yixibuxue territory was divided into three parts and officials were established to pacify and govern them.
translations.idiomatic: Yixibuxue territory was divided into three parts and officials were established to pacify and govern them.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: On guihai day the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，太白犯井。

translations.literal: On yichou day Venus transgressed Well.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Venus transgressed Well.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，罷淮南淘金司，以其戶還民籍。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the Huainan Gold-Washing Office was abolished and its households were returned to the commoner register.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Huainan Gold-Washing Office was abolished and its households were returned to the commoner register.

sentences.zh: 庚午，熒惑犯司怪。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Mars transgressed Office of Strangeness.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Mars transgressed Office of Strangeness.

sentences.zh: 新附官同文英入見，其贄禮銀萬兩、金四十錠，鐵木兒不花匿為己有，詔即其家搜閱，沒入官帑。

translations.literal: The newly submitted official Tong Wenying came to audience; his tribute gifts were ten thousand taels of silver and forty ingots of gold — Tiemu'erbuhua concealed them as his own; an edict ordered a search of his house and confiscation to the state treasury.
translations.idiomatic: The newly submitted official Tong Wenying came to audience with tribute of 10,000 taels of silver and 40 ingots of gold; Tiemu'erbuhua concealed them as his own, and an edict ordered a search of his house and confiscation to the state treasury.

sentences.zh: 敕捕阿合馬婦翁尚書蔡仲英，征償所貸官鈔二十萬錠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the arrest of Ahmad's father-in-law, Minister Cai Zhongying, and recovery of two hundred thousand ingots of government paper currency he had borrowed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the arrest of Ahmad's father-in-law, Minister Cai Zhongying, and recovery of 200,000 ingots of government paper currency he had borrowed.

sentences.zh: 阿八赤、姚演以開神山橋渠，侵用官鈔二千四百錠，折閱糧米七十三萬石，詔征償，仍議其罪。

translations.literal: Abaqchi and Yao Yan, for opening the Shenshan River bridge and canal, misappropriated two thousand four hundred ingots of government paper currency and registered seventy-three wan shi of grain fraudulently; an edict ordered recovery and further deliberation of their offenses.
translations.idiomatic: Abaqchi and Yao Yan, for opening the Shenshan River bridge and canal, misappropriated 2,400 ingots of government paper currency and fraudulently registered 730,000 shi of grain; an edict ordered recovery and further deliberation of their offenses.

sentences.zh: 壬申，亦奚不薛軍民千戶宋添富及順元路軍民總管兼宣撫使阿裏等來降，班師，以羅鬼酋長阿利及其從者入覲。

translations.literal: On renshen day Song Tianfu, military-civilian qianhu of Yixibuxue, and Ali, military-civilian zongguan and pacification commissioner of Shunyuan Route, and others came to submit; the army withdrew, and the Luo-gui chief Ali and his followers were brought to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Song Tianfu, military-civilian qianhu of Yixibuxue, and Ali, military-civilian zongguan and pacification commissioner of Shunyuan Route, and others submitted; the army withdrew, and Luo-gui chief Ali and his followers were brought to audience.

sentences.zh: 立亦奚不薛總管府，命阿裏為總管。

translations.literal: The Yixibuxue Headquarters was established and Ali was ordered to serve as zongguan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yixibuxue headquarters was established and Ali was ordered to serve as zongguan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，減江南十道宣慰司官一百四十員為九十三員。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Jiangnan's ten-route pacification commission posts were reduced from one hundred forty to ninety-three.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Jiangnan's ten-route pacification commission posts were reduced from 140 to 93.

sentences.zh: 敕上都商稅六十分取一。

translations.literal: An edict fixed Shangdu merchant tax at one-sixtieth.
translations.idiomatic: An edict fixed Shangdu merchant tax at one-sixtieth.

sentences.zh: 免大都、平灤兩路今歲俸鈔。

translations.literal: This year's salary paper currency of Dadu and Pingluan routes was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: This year's salary paper currency of Dadu and Pingluan routes was remitted.

sentences.zh: 立總教院，秩正三品。

translations.literal: The General Preceptorship was established at regular rank three.
translations.idiomatic: The General Preceptorship was established at regular rank three.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命按察司照刷土蕃宣慰司文卷。

translations.literal: On dingchou day surveillance commissions were ordered to audit the documents of the Tibetan pacification commission.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day surveillance commissions were ordered to audit the documents of the Tibetan pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 立鋪軍捕淮西盜賊。

translations.literal: Relay-station troops were established to capture bandits in Huai-xi.
translations.idiomatic: Relay-station troops were established to capture bandits in Huai-xi.

sentences.zh: 淮東宣慰同知宋廷秀私役軍四十人，杖而罷之。

translations.literal: Huai-dong pacification associate commissioner Song Tingxiu privately impressed forty soldiers; he was caned and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Huai-dong pacification associate commissioner Song Tingxiu privately impressed 40 soldiers; he was caned and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，給忽都帖木兒等軍貧乏。

translations.literal: On gengchen day impoverished troops under Hudutemur and others were granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day impoverished troops under Hudutemur and others received relief.

sentences.zh: 償怯兒合思等羊馬價鈔。

translations.literal: Paper currency was paid as price for sheep and horses to Qie'erhesi and others.
translations.idiomatic: Paper currency was paid as price for sheep and horses to Qie'erhesi and others.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，以明理察平章軍國重事，商議公事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on guiwei day, Minglicha was made privy councillor with charge of state affairs and deliberated on public business.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guiwei day, Minglicha was made privy councillor with charge of state affairs and deliberated on public business.

sentences.zh: 立懷來淘金所。

translations.literal: The Huailai Gold-Washing Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Huailai Gold-Washing Office was established.

sentences.zh: 甲午，敕大名、真定、北京、衛輝四路屯駐新附軍，於東京屯田。

translations.literal: On jiawu day an edict ordered newly submitted armies garrisoned on the Daming, Zhending, Beijing, and Weihui routes to garrison-farm at Dongjing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day an edict ordered newly submitted armies garrisoned on the Daming, Zhending, Beijing, and Weihui routes to garrison-farm at Dongjing.

sentences.zh: 安南國遣使以方物入貢。

translations.literal: Annam sent envoys bearing local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Annam sent envoys bearing local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太白犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Venus transgressed Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Venus transgressed Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，歲星犯鉤鈐。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Jupiter transgressed Gou Qian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Jupiter transgressed Gou Qian.

sentences.zh: 浙西道宣慰使史弼言：「頃以征日本船五百艘科諸民間，民病之，宜取阿八赤所有船，修理以付阿塔海，庶寬民力，並給鈔於沿海募水手。

translations.literal: Zhe-xi Route pacification commissioner Shi Bi said: "Recently five hundred Japan expedition ships were levied from the people, to their distress; it would be better to take the ships Abaqchi already has, repair them, and assign them to Atahai, thereby easing the people's burden, and also grant paper currency along the coast to recruit sailors.
translations.idiomatic: Zhe-xi Route pacification commissioner Shi Bi said, "Recently 500 Japan expedition ships were levied from the people, to their distress; it would be better to take the ships Abaqchi already has, repair them, and assign them to Atahai, thereby easing the people's burden, and also grant paper currency along the coast to recruit sailors.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 濟州新開河成，立都漕運司。

translations.literal: The new canal at Jizhou was completed, and the Capital Transport Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: The new canal at Jizhou was completed, and the capital transport commission was established.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賞還役宿衛軍。

translations.literal: On gengxu day palace guard troops returning from duty were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day palace guard troops returning from duty were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 賜皇子北安王所部軍鈔、羊馬。

translations.literal: Paper money, sheep, and horses were granted to the troops under Prince of Bei'an.
translations.idiomatic: Paper money, sheep, and horses were granted to the troops under the Prince of Bei'an.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，太白犯軒轅少女。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renzi day, Venus transgressed the Maiden of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on renzi day, Venus transgressed the Maiden of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，合剌帶等招降象山縣海賊尤宗祖等九千五百九十二人，海道以寧。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Heladai and others induced submission of the Xiangshan County sea bandits You Zongzu and nine thousand five hundred ninety-two others; the sea routes were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Heladai and others induced submission of the Xiangshan County sea bandits You Zongzu and 9,592 others, and the sea routes were pacified.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯鬥。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed Dipper.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，調黎兵同征日本。

translations.literal: On renxu day Li troops were mobilized to campaign against Japan together.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Li troops were mobilized for the campaign against Japan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，古答奴國因商人阿剌畏等來言，自願效順。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the country of Gudanu, through merchants including Alawei, came to declare its wish to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the country of Gudanu, through merchants including Alawei, declared its wish to submit.

sentences.zh: 並占城、荊湖行省為一。

translations.literal: Champa and Jinghu branch secretariats were merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: The Champa and Jinghu branch secretariats were merged into one.

sentences.zh: 徙舊城市肆局院，稅務皆入大都，減稅征四十分之一。

translations.literal: Old city's market bureaus, guild offices, and tax offices were all moved into Dadu; tax collection was reduced to one-fortieth.
translations.idiomatic: The old city's market bureaus, guild offices, and tax offices were all moved into Dadu, and tax collection was reduced to one-fortieth.

sentences.zh: 賞朱雲龍漕運功，授七品總押，仍以幣帛給之。

translations.literal: Zhu Yunlong was rewarded for grain transport merit, made chief supervisor of rank seven, and given silks.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yunlong was rewarded for grain transport merit, made a rank-seven chief supervisor, and given silks.

sentences.zh: 己巳，太白犯右執法。

translations.literal: On jisi day Venus transgressed Right Law.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Venus transgressed Right Law.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以歲登，開諸路酒禁。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, because the harvest was good, wine prohibitions in all routes were lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, because the harvest was good, wine prohibitions in all routes were lifted.

sentences.zh: 廣東盜起，遣兵萬人討之。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Guangdong; ten thousand troops were dispatched to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Guangdong, and ten thousand troops were dispatched to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太陰掩井。

translations.literal: On renshen day the moon occulted Well.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the moon occulted Well.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，熒惑犯鬼。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Mars transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Mars transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太陰犯鬼，熒惑犯積屍氣，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed Ghost, Mars transgressed Accumulated Corpse Qi, and Venus transgressed Left Law.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed Ghost, Mars transgressed Accumulated Corpse Qi, and Venus transgressed Left Law.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，史弼陳弭盜之策，為首及同謀者死，余屯田淮上，帝然其言。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Shi Bi proposed a plan to suppress banditry: ringleaders and co-conspirators were to die, and the rest were to garrison-farm on the Huai; the Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Shi Bi proposed a plan to suppress banditry: ringleaders and co-conspirators were to die, and the rest were to garrison-farm on the Huai; the Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 詔以其事付弼，賊黨耕種內地，其妻孥送京師以給鷹坊人等。

translations.literal: An edict entrusted the matter to Bi; bandit followers were to farm on inner territory, and their wives and children were sent to the capital to supply the hawk offices and others.
translations.idiomatic: An edict entrusted the matter to Bi; bandit followers were to farm on inner territory, and their wives and children were sent to the capital to supply the hawk offices and others.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，給征日本新附軍鈔三萬錠。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on gengyin day, thirty thousand ingots of paper money were granted to newly submitted troops on the Japan campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, on gengyin day, 30,000 ingots of paper money were granted to newly submitted troops on the Japan campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，車駕由古北口路至自上都。

translations.literal: On renchen day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu by the Gubeikou road.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu by the Gubeikou road.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，斡端宣慰使劉恩進嘉禾，同穎九穗、七穗、六穗者各一。

translations.literal: On gisi day Wanduan pacification commissioner Liu En presented fine grain, one stalk each of nine-, seven-, and six-ear grain growing from a single spike.
translations.idiomatic: On gisi day Wanduan pacification commissioner Liu En presented fine grain, one stalk each of nine-, seven-, and six-ear grain growing from a single spike.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以平章政事劄散為樞密副使。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Grand Councillor Zharsan was made vice director of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Grand Councillor Zharsan was made vice director of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 詔：「五衛軍，歲以冬十月聽十之五還家備資裝，正月番上代其半還，四月畢入役。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "The Five Guard armies each year in the tenth month of winter may have five-tenths return home to prepare equipment; in the first month those on duty shall rotate and half return; by the fourth month all enter service.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated, "The Five Guard armies each year in the tenth month of winter may have five-tenths return home to prepare equipment; in the first month those on duty shall rotate and half return; by the fourth month all enter service.
